Market.deco_one_plus_energy_desc_text: Place this decoration to speed up your max energy by 1
Market.macro_district_europe_description_text: A European District can house up to 36 European residences, businesses and community buildings.
Market.macro_nationalPark_description_text: Collect from the National Park Office to find Mystery Seedlings
Market.macro_dragoncastle_description_text: Finish both Dragon Castles to receive the Baby Pink Dragon!
Market.Promo_GreenHouse2_text: Build New Leaf Greenhouses to supercharge your farming!
Market.Promo_GreenHouse3_text: Build New Late Bloomer Greenhouses to supercharge your farming!
Market.macro_ice_factory_description_text: An Ice Workshop with two wings. Craft exclusive Ice Buildings!
Market.Snowman_Promo_Text: Build snowfolks to earn amazing prizes and decorate your city into a winter wonderland!
Market.Promo_marketcard_NYEGift2012_text: Earn 2013 themed rewards when you play our New Year’s Eve countdown!
Market.Promo_sandyrelief_text: Give your citizens the Good Samaritan Civic Center & give support to victims of Superstorm Sandy.
Market.Promo_TreasureChest_1_text: Collect from your Treasure Chest every week to double your city cash!
Market.Downtown1_Decoscene_text: Pre-designed scene includes 19 items.  CV Value of 2840 and CV Value Allowance of 1600.
Market.Downtown2_Decoscene_text: This pre-designed scene includes 12 items arranged to look fantastic. CV Value of 630 and CV Value Allowance of 2976.
Market.Europe_Decoscene_text: Scene contains 34 decorations and 5 building options.
Market.scene_kaboom_text: 100% of the proceeds go to building a REAL KaBOOM! playground!
Market.mun_super_city_center_fbc_popup_descript: Zynga et Communauté reverseront 100 % du prix d'achat à l'association Direct Relief International http://www.directrelief.org. Les achats des joueurs ne sont pas déductibles d'impôts.

Messages.RollCallCheckInBody: {ugc}Help! Pigeons have taken over my city hall in CityVille!  Help shoo them away by clicking on this link. {url}

Missions.snm_holiday_baker_task_1_reward: Merci! Now I can get to baking!
Missions.snm_holiday_baker_task_2_reward: I must've gotten the recipe wrong! This isn't a gingerbread cookie! It's a gingerbread man!
Missions.snm_holiday_baker_task_3_desc: Well, I can't let the gingerbread man go out into the cold like this! Let's get him a sweater!
Missions.snm_holiday_baker_task_4_desc: Let's pick her up so that the ginger couple can have a happy Holidays together!
Missions.snm_holiday_baker_task_4_reward: Aw, true love reunited! Reminds me of my time in Paris!
Missions.snm_holiday_baker_task_5_desc: The happy couple likes it so much here that they want to move into CityVille!
Missions.snm_holiday_baker_task_5_reward: What a beautiful gingerbread house! It looks good enough to eat!
Missions.snm_holiday_conductor_task_1_desc: Time to make my last trip before the holiday!
Missions.snm_holiday_conductor_task_2_reward: All the children are boarding the train in their pajamas!
Missions.snm_holiday_conductor_task_3_desc: Well, we might as well get some hot cocoa! This is going to be a wild ride!
Missions.snm_holiday_conductor_task_3_reward: That hit the spot! I just wish I knew where we were going!
Missions.snm_holiday_conductor_task_4_desc: We're headed to Holiday Town! Santa's waiting for us!
Missions.snm_holiday_conductor_task_5_desc: Where'd I put that whistle?! I must've dropped it!
Missions.snm_holiday_conductor_task_5_reward: What's this gift under the tree? Why, it''s my train whistle! Thanks, Santa!
Missions.snm_holiday_toymaker_task_1_desc: It's not the holidays without new toys! Let's ask the kids at the Grade School what they want!
Missions.snm_holiday_toymaker_task_2_desc: I need special parts from Sydney for my secret invention!
Missions.snm_holiday_toymaker_task_2_reward: This toy comes from a land down under! Let's just hope it goes over with the kids!
Missions.snm_holiday_toymaker_task_3_desc: We need to mass produce this for all the kids!
Missions.snm_holiday_toymaker_task_3_reward: It's ready to ship! I can't wait to see the kids faces when they open the box!
Missions.snm_holiday_toymaker_task_4_desc: The toy stores are begging me to put my new cute koala bear on their shelves for the holidays!
Missions.snm_holiday_toymaker_task_5_desc: The day is finally here! Kids are opening up their presents!
Missions.snm_holiday_toymaker_task_5_reward: The kids think the koala is magical! No, really! It's come to life all on its own!
Missions.snm_holiday_toymaker_task_6_desc: The koalas are not only a hit with the kids, they're a hit with adults!
Missions.snm_holiday_scrooge_task_1_desc: I better get to the bank before it closes for the holidays!
Missions.snm_holiday_scrooge_task_1_reward: I wish the bank never closed. Nothing gets in the way of making money!
Missions.snm_holiday_scrooge_task_2_reward: I can't believe my eyes! I see a ghost at the foot of my bed!
Missions.snm_holiday_scrooge_task_3_desc: This is nothing but a pub, spirit. I haven't come here in ages.
Missions.snm_holiday_scrooge_task_4_reward: My...my assistant, Walt Stumpford, lives here?! I had no idea he had such a beautiful family!
Missions.snm_holiday_scrooge_task_5_desc: You can't scare me, spirit. That's just some sick old man.
Missions.snm_holiday_scrooge_task_5_reward: That's...that's...me! And I'm all alone! I've seen enough, spirit! Take me home!
Missions.snm_holiday_scrooge_task_6_desc: I'm alive! I'm alive! I have to get going. There's something at the mall I must do!
Missions.snm_holiday_scrooge_task_6_reward: Happy holidays, Stumpfords! Walt, here's a bonus for all your hard work!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_past_task_2_desc: Mmm. Pastry and coffee sounds great right now.
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_past_task_2_reward: I remember when I first met Andre. It is great that his shop is still going strong!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_past_task_3_desc: I really want a salad right now. Who knew the Burger Joint would serve the best in town!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_past_task_3_reward: I wonder how many burgers have been served here since it opened!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_past_task_4_desc: The smell of strawberries reminds me of when I first met Rita!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_past_task_4_reward: And now you can look around and really see the fruits of your labor!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_past_task_5_desc: Today seems like a great day to walk by the pier!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_past_task_5_reward: The Shipping Pier really put our city on the map!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_past_task_6_desc: My great grandmother buried a time capsule around here a long time ago!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_past_task_6_reward: Wow! Check your inventory for my great grandmother's Founder's Statue.
Missions.snm_timeline_vance_present_task_1_desc: There are so many thriving neighborhoods to live in! Which one to choose?
Missions.snm_timeline_vance_present_task_2_desc: Not only do people love the city but so do the animals!
Missions.snm_timeline_vance_present_task_3_desc: The city is a shopping destination for locals and tourists alike!
Missions.snm_timeline_vance_present_task_3_reward: That reminds me, I need to buy Bella an anniversary present!
Missions.snm_timeline_vance_present_task_5_desc: Cars have really put the city in the fast lane!
Missions.snm_timeline_vance_present_task_5_reward: Even though I love driving, I prefer to fly myself.
Missions.snm_timeline_vance_present_task_6_desc: As Vance Valor, I love taking advantage of all the city has to offer!
Missions.snm_timeline_vance_present_task_6_hint: Build a Landmark.  Landmarks can be found under Themes in the Build Menu.
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_1_desc: The city is becoming a global destination!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_2_desc: The city is becoming a bustling metropolis!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_3_desc: Variety is not only the spice of life but it's the main ingredient -- in our city!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_3_reward: The citizens are hungry for opportunity and new experiences!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_4_desc: The city is leading the way in new agricultural technologies!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_4_reward: And the seeds you planted a long time ago will finally sprout your success!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_5_desc: The city will continue to make waves in the shipping industry!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_5_reward: And there are a few surprises waiting to be unloaded onto your docks!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_6_reward: You better make room for some really big news! Airport construction is set to begin!

Prey.standardDesc: I may look like just another bandit, but when it comes to the art of the steal, I'm the real deal.
Prey.nightDesc: The nighttime is the right time to steal. No matter how hard the cops try to catch me, they're always in the dark.
Prey.silentrobDesc: I have the right to remain silent!  I'm climbing the invisible ladder to the top of the crime world!
Prey.sneakinsallyDesc: You can't tame this wild mustang!  I'm gonna lasso this flea bitten town and rob it till the cows come home!
Prey.toniethetechieDesc: LOL!  All I need is a Wi-Fi signal and my laptop and I can clean your town out with just one click!
Prey.moversDesc: Brace yourself because we plan on carrying the load for all the criminals in this town!
Prey.karmaDesc: Hey, man, I make bank, not war.  Whether it's in a drum circle or a crime ring, I'm always centered, man.
Prey.robbinhoodDesc: I take from the rich and give to the poor!  It just so happens that I'M poor, too!
Prey.ashleyDesc: If there's enough room for my broom, there's enough room for me to squeeze in and clean up!
Prey.dogRetrieverDesc: I hope you have a heart of gold and decide to retrieve me!
Prey.dogGermanShepherdDesc: My bark is worse than my bite! I'll make sure to bark loud so you can find me!
Prey.dogPoodleDesc: I hope you rescue me soon because I'm badly in need of a pedicure!
Prey.dogKingCharlesDesc: Ugh, being lost is a royal pain! Send a search party at once!
Prey.dogDalmatianDesc: You shouldn't have a hard time spotting me! I'm 101% sure of it!
Prey.downtownStanleyDesc: Sometimes shift happens. And it just so happens that I got my eye on that there car of yours!
Prey.downtownKennyDesc: Nothing feels better than feeling the wind in your hair as you fly down the road in someone else's car!
Prey.downtownFreddieDesc: You're not the boss of me! I'm the boss of me! And I plan on bossing myself around in your car!
Prey.downtownOttoDesc: Like a lot of mechanics, I take your car out for a spin to see if it's running okay. I just don't plan on givin' it back!
Prey.downtownMinnieDesc: When my kids start driving me crazy, I just start driving! And it looks like your car could use a mother's touch!
Prey.downtownFrancisDesc: I have a need for speed! I also coincidentally have a need for speeding away from the cops in your car!
Prey.fishBassDesc: A common fish, requires a Level 1 Fishing Boat.
Prey.fishSharkDesc: A rare fish, requires a Level 3 Fishing Boat.
Prey.area51AdventurerDesc: Hint: collect more film from AREA 51 buildings!

Quest.skin_hint: You need to build the Remodel HQ before you can buy this skin!
Quest.unlockOnQuestLine: This item will be unlocked by completing {questname} on this quest line.
Quest.quest_manager_hint: Mouse over icons to view Quests. Click on icons to add to the side bar.
Quest.quest_manager_new_hint: Click on quest icons to add to the side bar.  Quests with an X can be hidden.
Quest.q_rename_city_dialog_finish: Brilliant! Keep building Houses and Businesses to grow your City!
Quest.q_pop_news_tutorial_newsContent: Will {user,name} Have What It Takes To Be Mayor?
Quest.q_pop_news_tutorial_invite_title: Grow your city faster with neighbors!
Quest.q_pop_news_tutorial_invite_message: Neighbors can send free energy, gifts and trains!
Quest.q_welcome_train_dialog_description: My trains always run on time! Here's free Goods for your city.
Quest.q_pop_free_gifts_message: It's free and a great way to help them get started.
Quest.q_build_neighborhood_task1_hint: HINT: Use the BUILD menu to build Houses. Houses increase Population.
Quest.q_plant_and_harvest_task2_hint: HINT: Click on the Plot of land after you harvest it, then select a crop to plant.
Quest.q_plant_and_harvest_dialog_hint: Crops make goods! So be sure to harvest your crops before they wither!
Quest.q_plant_and_harvest_dialog_finish: Thanks fer helpin'. Looks like you found a lost bunny in the fields! Share the news!
Quest.q_plant_and_harvest_intro: My family and I have so many chores to do. Can you lend us a hand?
Quest.q_collect_rent_task1: Collect Rent from Rita's Country Home behind the barn
Quest.q_collect_rent_dialog_finish: Thanks for stoppin' by! C'mon back soon to collect more. Tell friends about your progress!
Quest.q_collect_rent_dialog_header: C'mon by, I'm in the blue house behind the barn!
Quest.q_build_business_guide_dialog_finish: C'est bon! Tell friends about your new bakery, and I'll tell them you're running for Mayor!
Quest.q_build_business_guide_intro: Your growing population is impressive! Build me a magnifique bakery and you may earn my vote.
Quest.qm_upgrade_business_task3_hint: HINT: Ask your friends for help to upgrade faster.
Quest.qm_upgrade_business_dialog_hint: Upgrading businesses improves their payouts and gives them a new look!
Quest.qm_upgrade_business_dialog_finish: Your new Bakery has risen! Tell your friends about your new bakery. More upgradeable businesses will be coming soon.
Quest.qm_upgrade_business_intro: Upgrading your Bakery is where it's at. The look of your Bakery will be updated and it will earn you more coins per goods.
Quest.q_move_business_dialog_hint: Only your friends can send the chocolate I require. Ask them, s'il vous plait.
Quest.q_move_business_dialog_finish:
Magnifique! Sales are sure to go up!
 You'd make a great Mayor someday!
Quest.q_visit_neighbor_dialog_hint: HINT: Click Samantha's picture on the bottom bar, then click the VISIT button.
Quest.q_visit_neighbor_dialog_finish: Merci! I'm thinking you have the right recipe to be mayor. Tell your friends about your pastry tour!
Quest.q_visit_neighbor_dialog_header: I must examine the competition in other cities!
Quest.q_plant_flag_task1_hint: HINT: The City Flag is in the BUILD Menu under Decorations.
Quest.q_plant_flag_dialog_finish: Great! Now you can build a City Hall! Tell your friends you're now on the path to being an official city!
Quest.q_plant_flag_intro: You've made a solid start turning this town into an official city. Time to take it one step further!
Quest.q_build_post_office_dialog_hint: HINT: The Post Office is in your Inventory.
Quest.q_build_post_office_dialog_header: Build a Post Office to make your town into an official city!
Quest.q_place_statue_intro: What a cute 'lil bunny! Looks like she needs a home.
Quest.q_place_town_hall_dialog_hint: The City Hall will be your office, if you win the Mayoral election!
Quest.q_place_town_hall_dialog_header: Once there's a City Hall, we can choose a Mayor!
Quest.q_pop_news_mayor_nominated_newsContent: Will Mayor Bring Seaport And Worldly Goods To {cityname}?
Quest.q_train1_task1_hint: HINT: Silos are in the BUILD Menu under the Crate Icon.
Quest.q_train1_dialog_finish: Great job! You're on track for my trains. Tell your friends you're chuggin' along.
Quest.q_train1_dialog_header: I'll be shipping you tons of Goods. Get big silos!
Quest.q_train2_dialog_finish: Scouting is done! Tell your friend about the great train routes you discovered.
Quest.q_train3_dialog_hint: When these trains complete their routes, a fortune in trading opens up to you if you have the goods!
Quest.q_train3_dialog_finish: The Charlieville trains are gettin' ready to roll! Tell your friends to get aboard too!
Quest.q_train3_dialog_header: Click on the Train Platform and send trains to your friends!
Quest.q_train4_dialog_hint: If you can get me a nice breakfast, and I'll send a Charlieville train packed with goods!
Quest.q_train4_dialog_finish: Conductor Charlie loves his breakfast! Share his appetite for your mayoral run!
Quest.q_train4_dialog_header: I'm ready to depart Charlieville, but could use a good breakfast!
Quest.q_welcome_train_epilogue_message: You've unlocked trains from Charlieville! They're fast and have great returns!
Quest.q_charlie_train_dialog_description: I've dropped off these Goods to help support your mayoral campaign!
Quest.q_clear_the_forest_dialog_hint: Help me knock 'em down, and I'll help ya become Mayor!
Quest.q_clear_the_forest_dialog_finish: We've chopped 'em down and you're ready for buildin'. Share your axe-cellence with friends!
Quest.q_clear_the_forest_intro: I'm a simple man. Lumberjack by trade. Lookin' forward to life here and supportin' ya for Mayor.
Quest.q_clear_the_forest_epilogue: I wonder what secrets have been kept about the folks who first claimed this land?
Quest.q_clear_the_forest_epilogue_title: NEATO! YOU FOUND A TIME CAPSULE!
Quest.q_time_capsule1_dialog_hint: Is the key buried on Rita's farm? Harvest crops to search and see.
Quest.q_time_capsule1_dialog_finish: You've begun to reveal the secret past of the city. Share the historic news with friends.
Quest.q_time_capsule1_dialog_header: Open an "old" chapter and learn about the rich history of your new city!
Quest.q_time_capsule2_dialog_finish: You've unveiled a love letter from the past. Share this historic discovery!
Quest.q_time_capsule2_dialog_header: Go back in time and learn the history and mystery of the land.
Quest.q_time_capsule2_intro: The Museum archeologist dug up another capsule with a lovely mystery inside.
Quest.q_visit_neighbor4_dialog_hint: It's time to apply your chopping skills to help the neighbors.
Quest.q_visit_neighbor4_dialog_finish: Nice job on the neighbor's trees, they are truly pleased. Tell friends whatcha done!
Quest.q_visit_neighbor4_dialog_header: Be neighborly by helping another city clear their trees.
Quest.q_family_lodge_dialog_finish: My family and I are dern proud of our new home! Tell friends about your good will!
Quest.q_family_lodge_dialog_header: Build my family a home and we'll support you for Mayor!
Quest.q_family_feast_dialog_hint: I love big 'ol family feasts, will you help us with the ingredients?
Quest.q_family_feast_dialog_finish: What a great feast, we ate until we got lazy! Tell friends about your hunger to be Mayor!
Quest.q_mayor_prep_intro: Oh my gosh! The election is coming soon! Better get your budgeting skills in order.
Quest.q_more_businesses_dialog_finish: Good show! You got down to business in a big way. Your mayoral qualities are apparent.
Quest.q_expanding_ventures_task2: Place a Franchise in Samantha's city
Quest.q_expanding_ventures_task2_hint: HINT: click on an Empty Lot in Samantha's city.
Quest.q_expanding_ventures_dialog_hint: I'm counting on you to franchise a business in Samantha's city!
Quest.q_expanding_ventures_dialog_finish: Feel the power! You are now a successful franchiser. Your friends need to know about this!
Quest.q_expanding_ventures_intro: It's time to put your city on the map in more places than one by building franchises!
Quest.q_place_hq_task1_hint: HINT: The HQ is in your Inventory.
Quest.q_place_hq_dialog_header: Break ground now on your first HQ!
Quest.q_place_hq_intro: You'll need it to run the Franchises you have in other cities.
Quest.q_earn_star_task1: Click your HQ, then click Supply
Quest.q_earn_star_dialog_hint: Running a franchise is not for the weak. Future Mayors need only apply!
Quest.q_earn_star_dialog_finish: You've run your franchise and increased my confidence. Share your wealth of knowledge now.
Quest.q_expand_further_dialog_hint: Expand your franchise to 2 or more cities. You'll add an HQ floor for each one!
Quest.q_expand_further_dialog_finish: Talk about vertical success! You've added floors to your HQ. Tell your friends!
Quest.q_steady_income_task2_hint: HINT: click on Empty Lots in your Friends' cities.
Quest.q_steady_income_dialog_hint: The more often you supply a franchise, the more you'll earn!
Quest.q_steady_income_dialog_finish: Bravo! You're on your way to earning more stars! Ask friends if they're up to the task!
Quest.q_steady_income_dialog_header: The true test of running a franchise is longevity.
Quest.q_rita_garden_dialog_hint: All these items are in the BUILD Menu under Decorations.
Quest.q_rita_garden_dialog_header: This'd be a darlin' spot for a garden!
Quest.q_edgar_burger_task1_hint: You will need a population of 150 before you can build a burger joint.
Quest.q_edgar_burger_dialog_hint: You've started off great, now keep going strong with a convenient restaurant.
Quest.q_edgar_burger_dialog_header: Some food the whole family can enjoy.
Quest.q_edgar_burger_dialog_finish: Well done, indeed! With business finesse like this, your bid for mayor is sure to succeed.
Quest.q_build_chateau_dialog_finish: My Chateau is, as Andre would say, "Magnifique". Share your impeccable taste.
Quest.q_scout_competition_task1_hint: HINT: Click on businesses in other cities to send a tour bus.
Quest.q_scout_competition_dialog_hint: Check out the businesses in your neighbors cities.
Quest.q_scout_competition_dialog_header: Help make your business climate strong in our city.
Quest.q_scout_competition_dialog_finish: A very profitable quest! Share what it takes to succeed in business!
Quest.q_please_the_citizens_dialog_hint: Build a park and give them a pretty place to hangout.
Quest.q_please_the_citizens_dialog_finish: Awesome job of "greening up" by building a new park. Ask your friends to graze in the grass too!
Quest.q_please_the_citizens_dialog_header: The citizens are in need of some greenery in their scenery.
Quest.q_pigeon1_intro_title: HI I'M RUTH! PIGEONS ARE MY FRIENDS.
Quest.q_pigeon1_intro: They all call me crazzzzy! But the pigeons know better.
Quest.q_pigeon1_dialog_hint: Pigeons get sunburned easily! Give them some shade!
Quest.q_pigeon1_dialog_header: Pigeons need a place to sit. Build comfy benches!
Quest.q_pigeon1_dialog_finish: "Coo! coo!" The pigeons tell me they adore the picnic tables! Tell all pigeons the "coo!" news!
Quest.q_pigeon2_dialog_finish: The pigeons are no longer pooped! Share the scoop with your friends!
Quest.q_pigeon3_dialog_hint: My pigeons only eat organic, it gives their feathers a lovely sheen.
Quest.q_pigeon3_dialog_finish: The pigeons have given up garbage for organic. Share their positive change with friends!
Quest.q_pigeon4_dialog_finish: My pigeons are currently sprinkling the museum with their love. Share their joy!
Quest.q_pigeon4_dialog_header: Build the museum for my birdie friends and I.
Quest.q_pigeon4_intro: My dear, the pigeons have kept my secret for years: I'm actually quite rich.
Quest.q_increase_pop_dialog_hint: So get going now on getting more folks to live here!
Quest.q_increase_pop_dialog_finish: You're a very persuasive people producer! Many citizens moved here! Tell friends about your growth!
Quest.q_increase_pop_dialog_header: The city needs more folks to support it.
Quest.q_news_halfway_elections_newsContent: Mayoral Victory Ensures Seaport And Worldwide Influence For {user,name}
Quest.q_rita_cont1_dialog_hint: This time there's strawberry harvestin' and rent collectin' needed!
Quest.q_rita_cont1_dialog_finish: Once again you've been a heap of help! Let your friends know what a great helpin' hand you are!
Quest.q_rita_cont2_dialog_hint: There's nothin' nicer than offerin' to help the neighbors tend their crops.
Quest.q_rita_cont2_dialog_finish: The neighbors thank you for harvestin' and waterin' their crops. Share your pride with friends.
Quest.q_build_school_task1_hint: HINT: You can find the Grade School under Community Buildings in the Build menu.
Quest.q_build_school_dialog_hint: Here's your homework. Build me a lovely school where I can teach the children!
Quest.q_build_school_dialog_header: The kids need a place to learn!
Quest.q_news_school_built_newsContent: Election Getting Closer! Voters Getting Smarter!
Quest.q_safety_first_dialog_hint: You can find Stop Signs and Sidewalks under Decorations in the Build menu.
Quest.q_safety_first_dialog_finish: Thanks for the new stop signs and sidewalks! Tell friends the kids are safe!
Quest.q_place_to_play_task1_hint: HINT: You can find the Swing Set under Decorations in the Build menu.
Quest.q_place_to_play_dialog_hint: Kids love to play, so here's a new assignment: build a playground!
Quest.q_place_to_play_dialog_finish: The kids love the playground and the citizens will love you as Mayor. Tell friends!
Quest.q_elected_mayor_dialog_hint: I propose we test your mayoral mettle on two essential city needs!
Quest.q_elected_mayor_dialog_finish: The vote is in and you're officially Mayor! Share your political prowess!
Quest.q_news_elected_mayor_newsContent: {cityname} Celebrates Future Seaport With Fantastic Fireworks!
Quest.c_prepare_shipping1_intro: Time to set sail for the new seaport and that's your next challenge as the new Mayor.
Quest.c_prepare_shipping1_dialog_header: Get the waterfront ready for the seaport mate!
Quest.c_prepare_shipping2_dialog_hint: You can find Piers and Boats under Shipping in the Build menu.
Quest.c_prepare_shipping2_dialog_finish: Shiver Me Timbers! The pier is built and your boat is seaworthy. Tell friends to get goin'.
Quest.c_news_seaport_town_newsContent: Rumor: Governor Considers Capital City Move
Quest.c_world_tour1_dialog_header: Help me set sail as I go "far east!"
Quest.c_world_tour2_dialog_finish: You've successfully "battened down the hatches" in the Americas! Tell your friends of your success!
Quest.c_world_tour3_dialog_finish: Ahoy! My passage to Europe was full of adventure! Share the journey now!
Quest.c_world_tour3_dialog_header: Batten down the hatches! Set sail for Europe.
Quest.c_world_tour4_dialog_hint: I've returned with a ship-full of worldly Goods. Share the bounty and earn coins.
Quest.c_world_tour4_dialog_finish: Aye! The goods are delivered and the coins are yours. Share your riches.
Quest.c_world_tour4_dialog_header: Now that you're back it's time to get on track!
Quest.c_news_world_tour_newsSubHead: Captain Rusty Returns From Sailing The World
Quest.c_more_billy1_dialog_hint: Before our new venture, I need to ascertain just how fiscally fit you are!
Quest.c_more_billy1_intro_title: IT'S EDGAR AND I'M BACK IN YOUR BUSINESS!
Quest.c_more_billy1_intro: I have something up my expensive well-suited sleeves but I'm not ready to tell you yet.
Quest.c_more_billy1_dialog_header: Remember, I'm a serious mogul, so get business-y!
Quest.c_more_billy2_dialog_finish: You're about to take over the silver screen. Tell friends to join the cast!
Quest.c_more_billy2_dialog_header: It's time to save up before building a cinema empire!
Quest.c_more_billy3_dialog_hint: HINT: You may franchise any business to fulfill the last task.
Quest.c_more_billy3_dialog_finish: Great production! Share your cinematic smarts with friends.
Quest.c_more_billy3_dialog_header: Lights, Camera, Action! Make sure friends know what's playing!
Quest.c_more_billy4_dialog_hint: Your Cinemas are doing splendidly. Better marketing means awards and rewards!
Quest.c_more_billy4_dialog_finish: Your marketing tour has a happy ending with more business. Share the narrative with friends.
Quest.c_more_billy4_dialog_header: Test your marketing mettle in the movie biz!
Quest.c_expand_city_dialog_finish: Congrats on your progress! Share your expansive thinking with friends.
Quest.c_expand_city_intro: You've done an impressive job growing this city. Now, it's time to expand!
Quest.c_news_city_expanded_newsContent: Best Host City Could Become New Capital
Quest.c_little_italy1_dialog_finish: Buonissimo! The city now has a grande Italian quarter!  Share the atmosphere with friends.
Quest.c_little_italy1_intro: I'm here to bring my Italian heritage to "tutti quanti" (everyone!) in your city!
Quest.c_little_italy1_dialog_header: I miss "mi casa!" Help me feel welcome here!
Quest.c_little_italy2_task1: Collect Rent from Terraced Brownstones 20 times
Quest.c_little_italy2_dialog_hint: Ciao amico! No Italian quarter is complete without a grande restaurant.
Quest.c_little_italy2_dialog_finish: Grazzi! You've earned the Italian Restaurant for completing this goal!
Quest.c_little_italy3_dialog_hint: Build me an Italian restaurant that is "molto bello!" (Everything beautiful!)
Quest.c_grow_pop_dialog_hint: To be a Capital City you need to grow your city big-time!
Quest.c_grow_pop_dialog_finish: Your city has 2,000 citizens! Share your growth with friends.
Quest.c_grow_pop_intro: Moving the capital to a new city is on the ballot. Yours is in the running.
Quest.c_grow_pop_dialog_header: Expanding your population is a capital idea!
Quest.c_central_park_1_dialog_hint: If you build a central park, I may donate yet another gem to the city!
Quest.c_central_park_1_dialog_finish: You are such a love for creating my central park! Share the greenery and scenery with friends!
Quest.c_central_park_1_intro: I may be rich now, but I'm still crazy about parks, pigeons - and people too!
Quest.c_central_park_1_dialog_header: Build a central park for all pigeons and people
Quest.c_central_park_2_dialog_hint: The city's people and pigeon population is taking wing!
Quest.c_central_park_2_dialog_finish: The park is now sitting pretty thanks to the benches you've placed! Share your success!
Quest.c_central_park_3_dialog_finish: The neighbors love Ruth's new object d'art in the park. Share your artistic merit with friends.
Quest.c_state_fair1_dialog_hint: Hosting the State Fair would be a major coup! Apply your fiscal fortitude now.
Quest.c_state_fair1_dialog_finish: Your interest in the State Fair is noted by the powers that be. Share the progress with friends.
Quest.c_state_fair1_intro_title: GOVERNOR PHIL HERE TO TALK STATE FAIR!
Quest.c_state_fair1_intro: {cityname} is a candidate for this important and lucrative event!
Quest.c_state_fair2_task1: Have an Expo Tent Decoration placed in your city.
Quest.c_state_fair3_dialog_hint: Folks usually get famished at the State Fair! Get snacks ready!
Quest.c_state_fair3_dialog_finish: Great food for thought gathering State Fair snacks! Tell your friends of your hunger to succeed!
Quest.c_state_fair3_intro_title: GOVERNOR PHIL HERE WITH AN EDIBLE REQUEST!
Quest.c_state_fair3_intro: You can't have a State Fair without terrific snacks! I'm counting on you to supply them.
Quest.c_state_fair3_dialog_header: It's time to get snackin' for the State Fair!
Quest.c_state_fair4_dialog_finish: Everyone is merry about going 'round on the new Carousel! Share the ride with friends!
Quest.c_state_fair4_intro: The State Fair is one step away. And the Capital City very much in your future!
Quest.c_state_fair4_dialog_header: Time to get around to a new carousel!
Quest.c_more_andre1_dialog_hint: Take the search for new restaurant ideas to other culinary-rich cities!
Quest.c_more_andre1_dialog_finish: Excellent! I'll have our nouvelle restaurant idea soon. Share your culinary smarts with friends!
Quest.c_more_andre1_intro_title: SALUT! IT'S CHEF ANDRE WITH A REQUEST.
Quest.c_more_andre2_dialog_finish: Merci beaucoup! The new French restaurant is now open. Share this important event!
Quest.c_more_andre2_dialog_header: Use your best "food for thought" for a new restaurant concept!
Quest.c_more_andre3_dialog_hint: C'est tres importante that we add another restaurant in your magnifique city!
Quest.c_more_andre3_dialog_finish: Parfait! My new French restaurant is open! Share your triomphe!
Quest.c_more_andre3_dialog_header: Get tres constructive on my nouvelle restaurant!
Quest.c_prepare_capital_city_task3: Ask 8 friends to send Capital Endorsements
Quest.c_prepare_capital_city_dialog_hint: Your city is on-track to be the Capital.  Next step: Secure its financial future.
Quest.c_prepare_capital_city_dialog_finish: Success! Your city is a strong Capital City contender! Share the news!
Quest.c_prepare_capital_city_dialog_header: Prove you've got the right Capital ideas.
Quest.c_news_capital_celebration_newsContent: Rumor: Sports Team Looking For New Home!
Quest.c_capitol_sports1_task1_hint: HINT: The Batting Cage is in the Decoration section of the Build Menu.
Quest.c_capitol_sports1_dialog_hint: Before you recruit the team you must build places for them to train and live!
Quest.c_capitol_sports1_intro: I hear {cityname} is gunning to be the Capital City. An awesome sports team will help!
Quest.c_capitol_sports2_dialog_finish: Hot Dog! You've done it again and the fans will be well-fed. Tell your friends!
Quest.c_capitol_sports2_dialog_header: Give the fans what they want: food and drink!
Quest.c_capitol_sports3_dialog_finish: The field is finished and we've recruited a supreme team! Share the excitement!
Quest.c_capitol_sports3_dialog_header: Get serious about sports and finish the stadium!
Quest.m_fire_n_hospital_1_dialog_finish: That's a fine Fire Station indeed! Share your fire-ocity with friends!
Quest.m_fire_n_hospital_1_dialog_header: Building a Fire Station is a "hot" priority!
Quest.m_fire_n_hospital_1_intro: "Heat up" your campaign to become a Capital City! Build and supply a new Fire Station!
Quest.m_more_rita_1_dialog_hint: It takes lots of supplies to keep a Capital City goin! So start harvestin'!
Quest.m_more_rita_1_dialog_finish: Gosh! You're a lean, mean, harvestin' machine! Share your hard work!
Quest.m_more_rita_1_intro: Howdy! The city's looking great! Now show me you've got the goods!
Quest.m_more_rita_2_dialog_hint: Water the crops for the neighbors and help your city grow too!
Quest.m_more_rita_2_dialog_finish: The neighbors are darn pleased with your crop waterin'. Share how "damp good" you are!
Quest.m_more_rita_2_intro: Now be a sweetheart and visit the neighbors to tend to their crops!
Quest.m_more_rita_3_dialog_hint: Need to get those peas planted.  They take a while to grow.
Quest.m_more_rita_3_dialog_finish: Gosh! We're totally ready for the Pea Festival! Share your peas-full-ness with friends!
Quest.m_more_rita_3_intro: The Pea Festival's comin' to our city, so I need you to harvest lots of 'em!
Quest.m_more_rita_4_task1: Have a Corner Store in your city (From Pea Collection turn in)
Quest.m_more_rita_4_dialog_hint: Find a great corner for the new store and I'll be ever so thankful!
Quest.m_more_rita_4_dialog_finish: You really "cornered the market" for the new store! Share your "shop thinking"!
Quest.m_more_rita_4_dialog_header: A Corner Store would be handy and dandy!
Quest.m_more_rita_4_intro: Be a sweetheart and build a corner store for Sid to run that's close to my farm!
Quest.m_more_rita_4_epilogue2_message: My store is already doing good business from Rita and her friends!
Quest.m_fire_n_hospital_2_dialog_hint: I've been advised that the firemen are hungry! Get cooking to feed them!
Quest.m_fire_n_hospital_2_dialog_finish: A hearty meal for the fighters was super appreciated! Share your successful recipe.
Quest.m_fire_n_hospital_2_intro: My team gets very hungry on the job! Feed them to "fire-up" your Capital campaign!
Quest.m_fire_n_hospital_3_dialog_hint: Let's fight fire with fire! Help the firemen inspect and smoke detect!
Quest.m_fire_n_hospital_3_dialog_finish: I'm pleased to report there's now a smoke detector in every home. Put out the news!
Quest.m_fire_n_hospital_3_dialog_header: Help my firefighters with smoke detector awareness!
Quest.m_fire_n_hospital_4_dialog_hint: Building a new hospital gives you a healthier chance of becoming a capital city!
Quest.m_fire_n_hospital_4_dialog_finish: You built a hospital worthy of a future capital city! Share your patience (and patients!)
Quest.m_fire_n_hospital_4_dialog_header: Show your healthy respect by building a hospital!
Quest.m_fire_n_hospital_4_intro: Every Capital City needs a hospital. I lobby that you build one stat!
Quest.m_fire_n_hospital_4_epilogue_message: Look in your inventory for your new State Capitol Building!
Quest.m_fire_n_hospital_5_dialog_finish: The Capital Building looks great! Share some coins to celebrate!
Quest.m_mchandsome_1_task1_hint: HINT: Collect from Toy and Video Game stores.
Quest.m_mchandsome_1_task2: Collect from a Toy Store 5 times
Quest.m_mchandsome_1_dialog_hint: The comic books will be a super get well gift for my Children's Ward patients!
Quest.m_mchandsome_2_dialog_hint: The kids can't wait for the toys! No time to play around!
Quest.m_mchandsome_2_dialog_finish: The Toys were super gifts for the Children's Ward! Ask friends to play nice too!
Quest.m_mchandsome_2_dialog_header: Your homework: Please get toys for the hospital Children's Ward!
Quest.m_mchandsome_2_intro: Here's your homework! Help my Toy Drive to make Doctor Sheperd's Children's Ward more toy-full!
Quest.m_mchandsome_3_dialog_hint: My first date with Louise is happening soon! Bring on an amazing setting!
Quest.m_mchandsome_3_dialog_header: I need a cool place for a first date! Stat!
Quest.m_mchandsome_3_intro: Doctor's orders: Find an awesome first date place for me and Louise!
Quest.m_mchandsome_4_dialog_hint: My floral prescription: The more roses I have, the sooner I can ask Louise out!
Quest.m_mchandsome_4_dialog_finish: Your gifts rocked! Louise said "Yes!" to our date! Tell friends to get their roses now!
Quest.m_dating_1_task1_hint: HINT: Collect from Cosmetic Stores and Dance Studios.
Quest.m_dating_1_dialog_finish: I'm ready to rock for my hot date with the Doctor! Get friends to do their homework!
Quest.m_dating_1_dialog_header: Help me with a dress and shoes for my hot date!
Quest.m_more_edgar_1_dialog_hint: The more building you do in your city, the more capital business you'll earn!
Quest.m_more_edgar_1_dialog_finish: Well built! Your capital city is maturing according to my plan. Get friends constructive now!
Quest.m_more_edgar_1_dialog_header: Make building a fiscal and physical priority!
Quest.m_more_edgar_1_intro: Don't be spendthrifty! If you want to be a rich capital city, you need more mansions and hotels!
Quest.m_more_edgar_2_dialog_finish: Well done! The rich folks of your city are rolling in more dough! Tell friends to pay the rent!
Quest.m_more_edgar_2_intro_title: I SAY RICH FOLKS NEED RENT TOO!
Quest.m_more_edgar_2_intro: My rich friends don't feel flush enough! Show them your love by showing them the money!
Quest.m_more_edgar_3_dialog_hint: What fiduciary fun! Collect a million coins to make your city wealthy and wise!
Quest.m_more_edgar_3_dialog_finish: My reward makes your city look like a million coins! Tell friends to collect too!
Quest.m_more_edgar_3_dialog_header: A million coins are within your collective reach!
Quest.m_more_edgar_4_task1: Have a Mint placed in your city
Quest.m_more_edgar_4_dialog_hint: Let's get that Mint placed in the city! It's a real symbol of success!
Quest.m_more_edgar_4_dialog_finish: The unveiling of my decoration places your city in high regard! Share the event!
Quest.m_more_edgar_4_intro: Now that you have a million coins I'd be honored if you'd adorn your city with my fancy decoration!
Quest.m_dating_2_dialog_hint: We'll work on the romance if you supply the dinner, movie and snack!
Quest.m_dating_2_dialog_finish: The Doc and I couldn't be more excited about our first date plans! Tell friends to plan on it too!
Quest.m_dating_2_intro: I've got warm and fuzzy feelings about this date and I think the doctor's got a major crush!
Quest.m_dating_2_epilogue_message: Things are really coming together! Thanks for your help!
Quest.m_dating_2_epilogue2_title: YES, THANK YOU FOR THE DATE CHECK UP!
Quest.m_dating_2_epilogue2_message: As the new doctor in the city I appreciate your advice on the best date prescription!
Quest.m_dating_3_task3: Collect from a French Restaurant 3 times
Quest.m_dating_3_dialog_hint: Andre's French Restaurant is perfect for my second date with Louise! Make it so!
Quest.m_dating_3_dialog_finish: Date two with Louise was, as the French say, "Parfait!" Ask friends to plan one for us!
Quest.m_dating_3_dialog_header: Plan my second date to include something French!
Quest.m_dating_3_intro: My first date with teacher Louise was cool (and hot!) Help me do it the French way on date two!
Quest.m_dating_4_dialog_hint: We'd love to go down south to Rio! It's supposed to be beautiful right now.
Quest.m_dating_4_dialog_header: Make our international date a trip to remember!
Quest.m_dating_4_intro: Our next date has to be "out of this world!" Send us to South America!
Quest.m_dating_4_epilogue_message: What a romantic journey. Louise and I are definitely "an item!"
Quest.m_dating_4_epilogue2_title: LIKE THE DOCTOR SAID, WE HAD A BLAST!
Quest.m_dating_5_dialog_hint: We're happy you're all-aboard for our date. What do you think is next for us?
Quest.m_dating_5_dialog_finish: Our date was great "training" for being a couple! Share the experience with friends!
Quest.m_dating_5_dialog_header: Make sure our romance is "picking up steam!"
Quest.m_dating_5_intro: Help keep our romance "on track" by "engineering" our next date!
Quest.m_dating_5_epilogue_message: Nothing like a train ride to "steam up" a romance!
Quest.m_dating_5_epilogue2_title: HE'S SO FUNNY AND CUTE ISN'T HE?!
Quest.m_dating_5_epilogue2_message: I adored learning more about the world (and the doctor!) from the comfort of a train car!
Quest.m_dating_6_dialog_hint: Paris is the place where people fall in love. Will we fall for it too?
Quest.m_dating_6_dialog_header: We can't wait for our romantic trip to Paris!
Quest.m_dating_6_intro: When you transport us to the most romantic city in the world, who knows what will happen?
Quest.m_dating_6_epilogue_message: What a beautiful journey to spark our love! Wait till you find out what I asked Louise!
