Quest.qm_xpromo_frontier_dialog_hint: There's always a need for some city improvements and a better road fer sure!
Quest.qm_xpromo_frontier_intro: Your City's growin' like mad so let's get choppin' on some important chores!
Quest.qm_xpromo_frontier_epilogue_title: Things around here are growin' better than ever!
Quest.qm_xpromo_frontier_epilogue_message: Click OKAY to return to FrontierVille and claim your reward!
Quest.qm_xpromo_frontier2_dialog_hint: Great Job! Click the Claim Reward button to get your Chocolate in FrontierVille!
Quest.qm_xpromo_frontier2_dialog_finish: Don't be a stranger! There's plenty more work to be done! Share the experience (and coins) with friends!
Quest.qm_xpromo_poker_dialog_hint: If you locate my aces, I'm crazy enough to give you part of the pot!
Quest.qm_xpromo_poker_dialog_finish: Once you found my aces, the poker game was in the cards! Share the big deal with friends!
Quest.qm_xpromo_poker_dialog_header: I need my aces so I'm flush enough to play poker!
Quest.qm_xpromo_poker_epilogue_message: Check back in Zynga Poker to claim your reward!
Quest.qm_xpromo_poker2_dialog_hint: Great Job! Click the Claim Reward button to get your Chips in Zynga Poker!
Quest.qm_xpromo_farmville_task1: Ask friends to help find Rare Seedlings for Rita
Quest.qm_xpromo_farmville_dialog_hint: I've run out of seedlings for my garden! Could you be a dear and help me get some?
Quest.qm_xpromo_farmville_dialog_finish: Gee Willickers! Those are some of the purtiest seedlings ever! Seed your friends with the news!
Quest.qm_xpromo_farmvilleintro: Be a sweetheart and fetch me seedlings for my garden!
Quest.qm_xpromo_farmville_epilogue_title: Sweeet! You found the seedlings for my garden!
Quest.qm_xpromo_farmville_epilogue_message: Look for the 'Claim Your Reward goal on the left to collect your prize!
Quest.qm_xpromo_farmville2_dialog_hint: Great Job! Click the Claim Reward button to get your reward in Farmville!
Quest.qm_xpromo_farmville2_dialog_finish: Thanks for your help! Share the experience (and coins) with friends!
Quest.holiday_tree1_task1: Place the Holiday Tree from your Inventory
Quest.holiday_tree1_dialog_finish: What a perfect place for the Tree! Now it's time to really get growing!
Quest.holiday_tree1_epilogue_message: The Elves and I are anxious to see you decorate it!
Quest.holiday_tree2intro: Start decorating the Holiday Tree to really get things growing!
Quest.holiday_tree3_dialog_hint: Put some sparkling touches on your Holiday Tree: With more presents!
Quest.holiday_tree3_dialog_finish: Your merry friends have sent a boat-load of presents for your Holiday Tree!
Quest.holiday_tree3_dialog_header: Ask friends to keep up the holiday spirit!
Quest.holiday_tree3intro: Give {cityname} the brightest Holiday Tree ever!
Quest.holiday_tree3_epilogue_message: Now it's time to put the finishing touches on the Holiday Tree!
Quest.holiday_tree4_dialog_hint: Put the finishing touches on your Holiday Tree before I come to town!
Quest.holiday_tree4_dialog_finish: Your Holiday Tree is very merry and festive! Nice job!
Quest.holiday_tree4intro: Your tree is nearly bursting at the seams with presents! How much more can it handle?!
Quest.holiday_tree4_epilogue_message: The elves and I really fancy your Holiday Tree! I'll be visiting you soon!
Quest.qm_holiday_snow_ground_dialog_hint: Go to the 'Free gifts' page to send more Snow Flakes and Snowballs to friends.
Quest.qm_holiday_snow_ground_dialog_finish: Congratulations on unlocking the snow cover! Share a reward with your friends!
Quest.qm_holiday_snow_ground_dialog_header: Cover your city land with snow. By spring it will melt!
Quest.qm_holiday_snow_ground_epilogue_message: Turn on the snow by clicking BUILD, and clicking on Decorations.
Quest.qm_holiday_snowandlights_dialog_hint: Go to the 'Free gifts' page to send more Holiday Gifts to friends.
Quest.qm_holiday_snowandlights_dialog_finish: The snow fall and holiday lights are here! Share a reward with your friends!
Quest.qm_holiday_snowandlights_dialog_header: Add a snow top to all buildings and lights to houses!
Quest.qm_holiday_snowandlights_epilogue_messag: Turn on snow top and house lights by clicking BUILD, and clicking on Decorations.
Quest.qm_holiday_winterclothes_dialog_hint: Go to the 'Free gifts' page to send more Winter Gifts to friends.
Quest.qm_holiday_winterclothes_dialog_header: Your citizens are freezing! Collect winter clothing to keep them all warm!
Quest.qm_holiday_winterclothes_epilogue_messag: Turn on Winter Clothing by clicking BUILD, and clicking on Decorations.
Quest.neighbor_gate_quest_1_dialog_hint: Find some new friends to join you at the bookstore opening.
Quest.neighbor_gate_quest_1_dialog_finish: Congratulations on unlocking the bookstore! Share a reward with your friends!
Quest.neighbor_gate_quest_1_dialog_header: Invite Friends to the Bookstore Grand Opening!
Quest.neighbor_gate_quest_1_epilogue_message: You successfully opened the bookstore. You can now buy the bookstore from the marketplace.
Quest.neighbor_gate_quest_2_dialog_hint: Envelopes, packing peanuts, boxes and more! All found at The Packing Store!
Quest.neighbor_gate_quest_2_dialog_finish: Gosh! Your Packing Store is open and mighty handy! Ask friends build one in their city!
Quest.neighbor_gate_quest_2_intro: A Packing Store is the next big move for your city! You've gotta have one! It's in your inventory!
Quest.qm_cny1_dialog_hint: Celebrate the Lunar New Year with your neighbors and colorful decorations!
Quest.qm_cny1_dialog_finish: Neato! This will be the most exciting Lunar New Year ever! Tell your friends to share the tradition!
Quest.qux_noodleshop_hint: Before you can buy this, you must complete the Lunar New Year Quest.
Quest.qm_cny2_task2: Collect from a Noodle Shop 1 time
Quest.qm_cny2_dialog_hint: Make sure you have enough noodles and that the presents are mailed in time!
Quest.qm_cny2_intro: Gosh! It's swell that you're getting ready for the Lunar New Year! Next up, plan your big meal!
Quest.qm_cny2_dialog_header: Noodles are a "must-serve" at the Lunar New Year!
Quest.qm_cny3_intro: The Lunar New Year's so close I can almost hear the fireworks! Get "crackling" and be totally ready!
Quest.qm_storage_warehouse_dialog_finish: You did it! Hire friends to create more space in your Warehouse and store more decorations.
Quest.qm_storage_warehouse_dialog_header: Store away your old seasonal decorations and make room for new ones!
Quest.qm_storage_warehouse_deluxe_task1: Add more space to your warehouse by having four crew members staffed
Quest.qm_storage_warehouse_deluxe_task1_hint: HINT: Click on your Warehouse to ask your friends to staff it.
Quest.qm_storage_warehouse_deluxe_task3: Store a residence in your Deluxe Warehouse
Quest.qm_storage_warehouse_deluxe_dialog_hint: If you have at least four friends staffed in your Warehouse, you can click on it to upgrade it for free!
Quest.qm_storage_warehouse_deluxe_dialog_finis: Great job! Now you can store your businesses, residences, and community buildings in your Deluxe Warehouse!
Quest.qm_storage_warehouse_deluxe_dialog_heade: Now you can store your businesses, residences, and community buildings in your Deluxe Warehouse!
Quest.qm_rent_collector_dialog_finish: That's quite the crew you've assembled.  Maybe you can help me find a new chauffeur when you're done.
Quest.qm_rent_collector_2_dialog_finish: Looks like you're gonna make quite the landlord.  Now, if you'll excuse me, I'm off to buy a small island.
Quest.qm_rent_collector_2_dialog_header: We better fuel up so we don't get stranded on the side of the road for hours.  Time is money!
Quest.qm_clerk_office_dialog_finish: Neato! Your City Clerk's Office is open and staffed! Ask friends to add one to their city!
Quest.qm_factory_1_task1: Place and build the Factory from your inventory
Quest.qm_factory_1_dialog_hint: Factories are a major step to make your city an industry leader!
Quest.qm_factory_1_dialog_finish: Congrats on your first Factory! The machinery to grow your city is in place! Tell friends!
Quest.qm_factory_1_dialog_header: Place a Factory in your city from your inventory!
Quest.qm_factory_1_intro: Factories produce premium goods that give a bonus when you supply your businesses!
Quest.qm_factory_2_task1: Supply a business with premium goods
Quest.qm_factory_2_dialog_finish: Gosh! Your city's factory is a lean, mean, production machine! Share the "goods" news!
Quest.qm_factory_2_intro: It's swell that your Factory is up and running! Now it's time to get industrious and make the goods!
Quest.qm_visitor_center_dialog_hint: Build and staff the Visitor Center. You can find it in your inventory.
Quest.qm_visitor_center_dialog_finish: Great job opening the Visitor Center! Why not spread the news and share a reward with your friends?
Quest.qm_visitor_center_dialog_header: Invite Friends to work in your Visitor Center!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost1_dialog_hint: It's hard to believe Rusty's lost at sea! We have to get to the bottom of this, so I can recover my missing goods!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost1_dialog_finish: These supplies will help us in our search! Share some good with friends.
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost1_dialog_header: Gather a sea-rious amount of supplies for our search!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost1_intro: Rusty may be lost at sea with my valuable goods on-board! Rich rewards await if you find him!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost2_task2_hint: HINT: Collect from Seafood Restaurant and Tower Eats.
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost2_dialog_hint: Something's fishy about Rusty's disappearance. Lets assemble a search party for the rescue!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost2_intro: It's time to get down to business on the search for Rusty. Man (and woman) the search party!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost3_dialog_hint: If Rusty is really missing, a voyage to "sea where he is" is a sensible idea. Dont forget your life vests!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost3_intro: My money says a smart way to find Rusty is to head out to his common destinations!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost4_dialog_hint: It appears Rusty's not lost at sea. It's time to search closer to home!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost4_dialog_finish: We found many clues about Rusty in neighboring cities! Send friends to investigate!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost4_dialog_header: Visit neighbor's cities to expand your search!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost4_intro: Speed up your search for Rusty! Find clues to his whereabouts by visiting neighbor's cities.
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost5_task1_hint: HINT: The Diner offers this collection.
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost5_task2_hint: HINT: Collect from Cozy Cottage, Country Home, Spring Bungalow, and Lake House.
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost5_dialog_finish: Well done! You lured Rusty home from his tropical adventure! I've also secured a new shipping route for you!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost5_dialog_header: Find Rusty's favorite things to get him home.
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost5_intro: It turns out Rusty's not lost at all! He's on vacation in the Bahamas and plans to stay!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost5_epilogue_message: I am pleased you have returned from the tropics with my valuable goods!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost5_epilogue2_message: The Bahamas were hot mon! But your pancakes and chair were a mighty fine welcome back!
Quest.qm_retail1_task2: Collect from a Tofu Burger Joint 5 times
Quest.qm_retail1_dialog_finish: The pigeons and I are ready for a wild dinner with Edgar! Ask friends to prepare the meal!
Quest.qm_retail1_dialog_intro: The pigeons and I are going shopping to get goodies for our dinner with Edgar. Can you help?
Quest.qm_retail2_dialog_hint: Going shopping for suits with the pigeons and Ruth in tow should be a wild time!
Quest.qm_retail2_dialog_finish: The shopping trip suited me fine! But the pigeons couldn't find their size! Tell friends!
Quest.qm_retail2_dialog_intro: We're going shopping to find me some designer suits, and my fancy car requires a big parking space.
Quest.qm_retail3_task3_hint: HINT: Tofu Burger, Department Store, and Grocery Store offer this collection.
Quest.qm_retail3_dialog_finish: Our fine feathered friends had a lovely time on their shopping spree and so did we!
Quest.qm_retail3_dialog_header: Help the pigeons' shopping spree take flight!
Quest.qm_retail3_dialog_intro: The pigeons want to go shopping too, so we convinced Edgar to fly with us to a neighboring city.
Quest.m_reporter1_task3: Place 1 Pink Flowers (From Forever Young Collection turn in)
Quest.m_reporter1_dialog_hint: I'm sure people (and Ruth's pigeon friends) will fly here to see the exhibits!
Quest.m_reporter1_intro: I'm interviewing the city's most important characters about a day in their lives, starting with Ruth!
Quest.m_reporter2_dialog_hint: Watching Paul whittle is so much fun. His carvings are "chop notch!"
Quest.m_reporter2_dialog_finish: Paul whittled me an amazin' tree carving I'll cherish forever! And his jam was yummy! Tell friends!
Quest.m_reporter2_intro: Next up for my interviews with city characters is Paul. I think we're going chopping together!
Quest.m_reporter3_dialog_hint: Andre's magnifique cake requires your care and carrots to get it into the oven!
Quest.m_reporter3_dialog_finish: C'est fini! Andre's put the icing on his one-of-a-kind carrot cake for me! Ask friends to bake one!
Quest.m_reporter3_dialog_header: Mix up the ingredients for Andre's carrot cake!
Quest.m_reporter4_task1: Collect from an Italian Restaurant 5 times
Quest.m_reporter4_dialog_hint: To make the pizza, Andre's dough-pending on you!
Quest.m_reporter4_dialog_finish: "Grazzi" to Lorenzo for the dough tossing lesson and the "perfecto" pizza! Tell friends "Get doughing!"
Quest.m_reporter4_dialog_header: Gosh! Can you supply the pizza dough ingredients?
Quest.m_reporter4_intro: I can't wait to make conversation and dough with Lorenzo whose pizza making skills are legendary!
Quest.m_reporter5_task3: Collect from a Pool Hall 10 Times
Quest.m_reporter5_dialog_finish: You're an all-star! The team and I had a ball celebrating their victory! Share your score!
Quest.m_reporter5_dialog_header: Go to bat to help Jack's hungry team celebrate!
Quest.m_reporter5_intro: Our baseball team won again! I can't wait to hang with Coach Jack and the players as they celebrate!
Quest.m_reporter6_dialog_hint: When it comes to Edgar's shoes, you need to truly shine!
Quest.m_reporter6_intro: Before our resident mogul will converse with me, he wants to be sure he's polished! His shoes that is!
Quest.m_reporter6_epilogue_message: Edgar has just donated a lovely Tree House for the city! Look for it in your inventory!
Quest.m_pop_news_reporter_newsContent: Readers Learn What Makes Edgar, Paul, Andre and Jack Tick!
Quest.m_andre_wedding1_task1_hint: HINT: French Restaurant offers this collection.
Quest.m_andre_wedding1_task3: Collect from any French Restaurant 5 times
Quest.m_andre_wedding1_dialog_hint: The wedding meal must be genius! Let's start with my crusty French bread!
Quest.m_andre_wedding1_dialog_finish: Mais qui! The smell of fresh bread and love fill the air! Tell everyone it's bake time!
Quest.m_andre_wedding1_intro: Magnifique! To prepare for Louise and Dr. Sheperd's big day I must begin baking immediately!
Quest.m_andre_wedding2_dialog_hint: The wedding is upon us! There's no time to waste in getting the dinner ready!
Quest.m_andre_wedding2_dialog_finish: My wedding dinner is set with flowers and Eggplant Parmesean! Ask friends to get cheesy!
Quest.m_andre_wedding2_intro: My wedding dinner must be superb from les fleurs (flowers!) to the fromage (cheese!)!
Quest.m_andre_wedding3_task1_hint: HINT: Collect from Wedding Stores and Tuxedo Rentals.
Quest.m_andre_wedding3_task2: Have 6 Chocolate Covered Strawberries (Strawberry Crop Collection)
Quest.m_andre_wedding3_dialog_finish: The doctor and teacher say my wedding cake is "magnifique!" Tell friends to make the cake!
Quest.m_andre_wedding3_dialog_header: Make sure you're "in the mix" for my cake!
Quest.m_andre_wedding3_intro: Cutting the cake is my favorite part of a wedding. No cutting corners pour moi!
Quest.m_get_married_1_task2: Collect from any Jewelry Store 5 times
Quest.m_get_married_1_dialog_finish: I love my new diamond ring! Your jewelry store rocks! Ask friends to put a ring on it!
Quest.m_get_married_1_intro: I've learned you have a jewelry store in your city where I can choose my ring!
Quest.m_get_married_2_dialog_finish: My wedding dress will get the highest marks for sure. Tell friends to get dressed!
Quest.m_get_married_2_dialog_header: Find me the perfect dress, pearls and tiara!
Quest.m_get_married_2_intro: I've got the diamond, so it's time to address the dress! And the pearls too!
Quest.m_get_married_3_task3: Collect from any Tuxedo Rental Store 5 Times
Quest.m_get_married_3_dialog_finish: My shiny blue Tuxedo will make Louise swoon! Tell friends to get their tux store on!
Quest.m_get_married_3_dialog_header: Find me a tux that would make a penguin jealous!
Quest.m_get_married_3_intro: The wedding's getting close, which means it's tux time. I hope you have something in-store for me!
Quest.m_get_married_4_task2: Collect from any Wedding Store 5 times
Quest.m_get_married_4_dialog_hint: Whaddaya say we make the bridesmaids fall in love with the handsome groomsmen!
Quest.m_get_married_4_dialog_finish: My groomsmen are almost as handsome as me! Make sure your neighbors groomsmen are linked!
Quest.m_get_married_4_dialog_header: Help my groomsmen accessorize to the max!
Quest.m_get_married_5_dialog_hint: I know you can help us find a beautiful wedding location in your city! Hint: Wedding Pavilions are located under Decorations in the Build Menu.
Quest.m_get_married_5_dialog_finish: We found a place we both agreed was totally us! Share this with friends!
Quest.m_get_married_5_dialog_header: Help us find the perfect place to say our vows!
Quest.m_get_married_5_intro: It's the most romantic moment so far! The place where we'll get married!
Quest.m_get_married_6_dialog_finish: You've made everything perfect for our wedding! Thank you! Tell friends to decorate too.
Quest.m_get_married_6_dialog_header: Everything must be perfect for our wedding, especially the decorations!
Quest.m_get_married_6_intro: All that's left are the final wedding decorations and we'd love your help!
Quest.m_get_married_6_epilogue_message: The decorations are in place and the benches are ready for our guests!
Quest.m_get_married_7_task1: Have a Newlywed House in your city (Turn in Bridal Collection)
Quest.m_get_married_7_intro: Now that we're a married couple, we need a place to call home sweet home!
Quest.m_get_married_7_epilogue_message: Thanks for all your help. Here's a photo from the wedding to hold on to!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_1_dialog_hint: When the Sing-a-long's ready, your city will be "fine as a fiddle" for St. Pattys! Unlock: St. Patty's Pub
Quest.qm_st_pattys_1_dialog_finish: Charlie and I can't wait to hit the new pub for a game of darts! Ask friends to build one!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_1_intro: We love socializin' on St. Patty's Day. Would'ya build an Irish pub with enough mugs to go 'round?
Quest.qm_st_pattys_2_dialog_hint: Andre needs your help with cookin' up a Corned Beef and Cabbage dinner!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_2_dialog_finish: Andre's St. Patty's Day meal is gonna hit the spot fer sure! Ask friends to get cookin'!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_2_intro: As a first generation Irishman, I love St. Patrick's Day! Let's put on the green in your city!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_3_task1_hint: HINT: Painting Booth can be found in the Decorations section of your Build menu.
Quest.qm_st_pattys_3_task2: Ask friends for 10 Face Paint Jars
Quest.qm_st_pattys_3_dialog_hint: There'll be lotsa requests for shamrocks 'n clovers painted on the kid's faces! Reward: St. Patrick's Park
Quest.qm_st_pattys_3_dialog_finish: Gee Willickers! The kids are lovin' wearin' the green on their faces! Ask friends to get painting!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_3_dialog_header: Help supply Rita and Sid's Face Painting Booth!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_3_intro: Be a sweetheart and lend Sid a hand with a St. Patrick's Day face painting booth in his store!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_4_task2_hint: HINT: Clover Patch can be found in the Decorations section of your Build Menu.
Quest.qm_st_pattys_4_dialog_finish: Ruth was disappointed I didn't bring anything for her pigeons! Ask friends to go to the park!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_4_dialog_header: Help Edgar with his clover bouquet for Ruth!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_5_dialog_finish: My fiddling was a high note for Ruth and her pigeons' St. Patrick's Day! Ask friends to play too!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_5_intro: I need to acquire a fiddle shop so I can serenade Ruth and her pigeons 'til their Irish eyes smile!
Quest.qux_irishrestaurant_hint: Before you can buy this, you must complete the St. Patrick's Day Quest.
Quest.qm_russian_ballet1_dialog_hint: Please welcome my troupe with a comfortable place to live and "limber up!"
Quest.qm_russian_ballet1_dialog_finish: You've made some smooth moves to welcome my dance troupe to your city! Tell friends!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet1_dialog_header: Get your city in shape for the Russian dancers!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet1_intro: I lead a Russian ballet troupe that will perform in your city! Prepare for our visit!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet2_task1_hint: HINT: Find the Fine Arts Theatre under Community Buildings in the Build Menu.
Quest.qm_russian_ballet2_dialog_hint: It's my wish that our dance performance is a cultural high note for your city!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet2_dialog_finish: I admire the design of your city's Fine Arts Theatre! Share your success with friends.
Quest.qm_russian_ballet2_dialog_header: Build your city's first Fine Arts Theatre!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet2_intro: I would be honored if you would build my troupe a Fine Arts Theatre for our dance debut!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet3_dialog_hint: My troupe and I need leotards and make-up! We're depending on you!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet3_dialog_finish: Thank you for outfitting my dancers for the performance! Share your success with friends!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet3_dialog_header: Help Alexi replace what's in the lost luggage!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet3_intro: We are quite excited to dance in your city, but our luggage is missing with all of our clothing!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet4_task1_hint: HINT: You can find the Dance Studio under Businesses in the Build Menu.
Quest.qm_russian_ballet4_task2: Collect rent from any Dance Studio 5 times
Quest.qm_russian_ballet4_dialog_hint: My dancers and I will add to your city's culture! Please build a Dance Studio!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet4_dialog_finish: Da! Our Dance Studio is finished and we are proud to live in your city! Share the news!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet4_dialog_header: Build a Dance Studio for Alexi and his troupe!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet4_intro: My troupe and I enjoyed dancing in your city so much! Can you help us move here from Russia forever?
Quest.qux_performancetheater_hint: Before you can buy this, you must complete the Dance in the City Quest.
Quest.qux_dancestudio_hint: Before you can buy this, you must complete the Fine Arts Theatre Quest.
Quest.s_lorenzo_family1_task3: Send tour buses to 4 neighbor's Bakeries
Quest.s_lorenzo_family1_dialog_hint: My papa's very demanding, so it's wise to have everything he needs!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family1_dialog_finish: Grazie! Preparations for my family's visit are looking "benissimo"! Tell friends to get ready too!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family1_intro: My papa just told me "mi famiglia" will be visiting soon. There's so much to get ready!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family2_task1: Collect from 6 neighbor's Terraced Brownstone Houses
Quest.s_lorenzo_family2_task3: Collect from any 2 Banks in your city
Quest.s_lorenzo_family2_dialog_hint: Mama, papa, sisters, brothers, uncles, aunts! That's a lotta people to house!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family2_dialog_finish: Grazie mille! You've found lotsa room for "mi famiglia!" Ask friends to make space!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family2_intro: My family's visiting and my house is too small for them all! Find them a "grande" place to live!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family3_task3: Find 1 Fried Tomato from the Tomato Collection
Quest.s_lorenzo_family3_dialog_hint: My family isn't easily impressed! That's why we must show them my success!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family3_dialog_finish: Grazie! My family thinks I'm "un grande affare"(a big deal) in your city! Spread the word!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family3_intro: My "famiglia" is curious to see and taste the joys and smells of Italy we've brought to your city!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family4_dialog_finish: My niece feels "molto better!" The Toys and Cards worked! Ask friends to send cheer!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family4_dialog_header: Send gifts to help Lorenzo's niece feel better!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family4_intro: My niece is in the hospital with an allergic reaction. She'll be fine, but needs some cheering up!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family4_quest_epilogue_message: My niece is out of the hospital and says "Ti amo!" for the Toys and Cards!
Quest.qux_italiandeli_hint: Before you can buy this, you must complete the House The Family Quest.
Quest.qux_pizzeria_hint: Before you can buy this, you must complete the Sneezy Niece Quest.
Quest.qm_gremlinsminigame_dialog_finish: You sure know your AC from your DC 'cause you took the juice out of the Energy Bandits!
Quest.qm_gremlinsminigame_dialog_header: You've got 30 seconds to catch as many Energy Bandits as you can!
Quest.qm_gremlinsminigame_intro: If I were you, I'd be guarding my energy! The energy bandits have been seen in your town!
Quest.qm_monsterbanditsminigame_dialog_header: You've got 60 seconds to catch as many Ghosts as you can!
Quest.qm_monsterbanditsminigame_intro: If I were you, I'd be guarding my energy! Ghosts have been seen in your town!
Quest.qm_hardware1_dialog_hint: A Hardware Store's where I come up with some of my best buildin' ideas fer sure! You can now find it in your inventory.
Quest.qm_hardware1_dialog_finish: Well don'tcha know! Your Hardware Store's my most valuable tool! Ask friends to build one!
Quest.qm_hardware1_dialog_header: Collect from the Hardware Store, you might find the building materials you need!
Quest.louise_college1_task1: Have 1 College Library in your city
Quest.louise_college1_task1_hint: HINT:  Find the College Library under Community Buildings in the Build Menu.
Quest.louise_college1_dialog_hint: This is no ordinary library. The College Library is through the roof with books!
Quest.louise_college1_intro: I have some important homework for you to help improve the education in my school!
Quest.louise_college2_task2: Collect 1 Fountain Pen from the Bookworm Collection (from the Bookstore)
Quest.louise_college2_task3: Collect rent from 40 Residences in your city
Quest.louise_college2_dialog_hint: Having a community college is key to the kids having a great education in your city!
Quest.louise_college2_dialog_finish: Well done! You really applied yourself to my community college funding assignment! Tell friends!
Quest.louise_college2_intro: Now that my school has passed the test, we need a community college for the children after they graduate!
Quest.louise_college3_task3: Collect from any Bank 2 times in your city
Quest.louise_college3_dialog_hint: Support industry in your city first! Louise's community college will just have to wait!
Quest.louise_college3_dialog_finish: Thank you for understanding that business is an education in itself. Inform your friends.
Quest.louise_college3_intro: This may not make me popular, but industry must prevail at the expense of higher education!
Quest.louise_college4_dialog_hint: If you want your city to be super smart, a community college is the right answer!
Quest.louise_college4_dialog_finish: The kids and I appreciate your brilliant support of our higher education effort. Educate friends!
Quest.louise_college4_dialog_header: Make sure education wins in your city!
Quest.louise_college4_intro: My students and I want to send Edgar "back to school!" Help us continue to fund the community college!
Quest.louise_college5_dialog_hint: If I vote in favor of higher education, it's sure to happen! Fund this effort!
Quest.louise_college5_dialog_finish: It's official! The community college in your city has been approved and budgeted! Inform friends!
Quest.louise_college5_intro: I've been convinced! I am in favor of funding the new community college for your city and need your support!
Quest.qux_communitycollege_hint: In order to purchase this item, you must finish the Edgar's college try quest!
Quest.louise_college7_task1_hint: HINT: Find the Community College under Community Buildings in the Build Menu.
Quest.louise_college7_dialog_hint: The Community College will be an important addition to your city! Build it now!
Quest.louise_college7_dialog_finish: The Community College is built and I give you an A+ for your effort! Ask friends to build theirs!
Quest.louise_college8_dialog_hint: Ornithology's not only for the birds! My feathered friends can teach you a lot!
Quest.louise_college8_dialog_finish: My pigeons and I are ready to share the poop in our ornithology class! Share with friends!
Quest.louise_college8_intro: Surprise! I have a Doctorate in Ornithology and want to let it fly by teaching at your college!
Quest.qm_cruiseship_dock_task2: Place 4 New Decorations Near City Port
Quest.qm_cruiseship_dock_dialog_hint: The City Port must be placed next to water.
Quest.qm_cruiseship_dock_dialog_finish: Great job! Building your City Port puts you on course for Cruise Ships! Tell friends!
Quest.qm_cruiseship_dock_dialog_header: Build a City Port to unlock Cruise Ships!
Quest.qm_cruiseship1_dialog_finish: Now tourists can find the best sites in your city and get there in style! Tell friends!
Quest.qm_cruiseship1_dialog_header: Get Tourism Pamphlets and Tour Buses!
Quest.qm_cruiseship2_dialog_finish: Your City Port looks great and is ready for business from a ton of tourists! Tell friends!
Quest.qm_cruiseship2_intro: It's time to finish building your City Port and grow population to meet arriving passengers!
Quest.qm_cruiseship2_epilogue_message: Cruise Ships pay out lots of coins and unload tons of tourists to speed up businesses in your city!
Quest.qm_cruiseship3_dialog_finish: Your city is ready to celebrate the arrival of Cruise Ships! Share the news!
Quest.qm_cruiseship3_dialog_header: Make sure your businesses are well stocked!
Quest.s_museum_dialog_header: Help Rita and Max explore your city's history!
Quest.s_museum_intro: Dig this! While helping Rita harvest her crops, I found remnants of a Log Cabin deep in the dirt!
Quest.s_museum_2_dialog_finish: The more we dig up, the more we learn about your city's history! Ask friends to explore!
Quest.s_museum_2_dialog_header: Help Max go deeper to research the Log Cabin!
Quest.s_museum_2_intro: No bones about it! The museum staff and I must discover more about the old Log Cabin artifact!
Quest.s_museum_3_dialog_hint: My students can't wait to dig in and learn about your city's past!
Quest.s_museum_3_intro: I'm so excited for my students to learn about archeology by helping Max excavate the old Log Cabin!
Quest.s_museum_4_task1_hint: HINT: You can find the Log Cabin in your inventory.
Quest.s_museum_4_dialog_finish: Your Log Cabin replica got the popular vote from tourists and students! Share the news!
Quest.s_museum_4_intro: I vote that you honor your city's ancient history and build a replica of the old Log Cabin!
Quest.s_museum_5_news_newsContent: Old Log Cabin, New Archeologist Making History!
Quest.s_museum_6_dialog_hint: The students will learn a lot if I can convince Max to join my school.
Quest.s_museum_6_dialog_finish: It's a great day for learning! Max agreed to teach at my school! Share the news!
Quest.s_museum_6_dialog_header: Help Louise go old school with Archeology!
Quest.s_museum_6_intro: That's why I want Max to teach science at my school! Your homework: Make it happen!
Quest.s_museum_7_task2_hint: HINT: Find the Children's Center under Community Buildings in the Build Menu.
Quest.s_museum_7_task3: Collect from Children's Discovery Center 3 times
Quest.s_museum_7_dialog_finish: I'm feeling better because Louise loves the new Discovery Center. Tell friends as well!
Quest.s_museum_7_dialog_header: Build the Discovery Center the doctor has ordered!
Quest.s_museum_7_intro_title: How are you? It's Dr. Shepherd!
Quest.s_museum_7_intro: I'd like to get involved with Louise and Max's science program! Let's build a Discovery Center!
Quest.s_museum_7_epilogue_message: You're welcome Louise! I love digging up history!
Quest.qux_sciencecenter_hint: In order to purchase this item, you must finish the Cabin Copy Quest!
Quest.qm_eating_contest1_dialog_hint: In this contest, the best way to get in shape is eating a lot!
Quest.qm_eating_contest1_dialog_header: Supply food for the eating contest trainees!
Quest.qm_eating_contest1_intro: Paul, Charlie and Phil are gettin' ready to enter an eating contest! May the hungriest man win!
Quest.qm_eating_contest2_dialog_hint: The key to winning the eating contest is having an endless supply of energy!
Quest.qm_eating_contest2_intro: It's hard to stay fit and prepare for the eating contest. I've got to pack in a lot of training!
Quest.qm_eating_contest3_dialog_hint: I need some heavyweight training or I'll be the caboose in the eating contest!
Quest.qm_eating_contest3_dialog_finish: Thanks for the workout! I'm on schedule to win the eating contest! Alert friends!
Quest.qm_eating_contest3_dialog_header: Help Charlie with his new training regimen!
Quest.qm_eating_contest3_intro: I've been in training forever but getting on track for this eating contest is a huge challenge!
Quest.qm_eating_contest4_dialog_hint: I think the calories count more than the popular vote in this contest!
Quest.qm_eating_contest4_dialog_finish: Thank you for supporting my eating contest campaign! Tell friends I'm hungry to win!
Quest.qm_eating_contest4_intro: The eating contest day has arrived and the polls predict I'm going to win by a landslide!
Quest.qm_eating_contest5_dialog_finish: What an upset! And I don't mean stomach! Ruth's pigeons flew in to win the eating contest!
Quest.qm_quest_epilogue_message: Coo! Coo! We won! Coo! Coo! Do you have any birdseed to calm our little stomachs?
Quest.qux_eatingconteststage_hint: You must complete the Eating Contest Questline to unlock this!
Quest.qm_zoo_arctic_intro: Wildlife is my life! I need your help to build a Zoo Habitat for the Arctic Animal I've rescued!
Quest.qm_arctic_zoo_dialog_header: Make the Arctic Animal welcome in its habitat!
Quest.qm_zoo_1_task2_hint: HINT: Click on the Jungle Habitat to open the Zoo Menu.
Quest.qm_zoo_1_intro: Wildlife is my life! I need your help to build a Zoo Habitat for the Jungle Animal I've rescued!
Quest.qm_zoo_2_dialog_hint: Click on a Habitat to Ask Friends for more animals!
Quest.qm_zoo_2_dialog_finish: Exceptional! You have two happy Jungle Animals in your new Zoo! Tell friends to go zoo-ey!
Quest.qm_zoo_2_dialog_header: Give your Jungle Animal a best friend!
Quest.qm_zoo_3_dialog_hint: You're on the right track to make your Zoo attractive to citizens and tourists!
Quest.qm_zoo_3_dialog_finish: Brilliant work! It's truly in your nature to give folks a world-class Zoo! Share the news!
Quest.qm_zoo_3_intro: If you want your Zoo to be a real tourist attraction, get the funds to make it more fun!
Quest.qm_zoo_4_dialog_hint: I hear your Cafeteria will serve "Corn On A Stick!" What a healthy treat!
Quest.qm_zoo_4_dialog_finish: Yum! Your Zoo visitors are really enjoying the Cafeteria! Share the tasty news!
Quest.qm_zoo_4_dialog_header: Give your Zoo visitors a Cafeteria!
Quest.qm_zoo_4_intro: Make sure your visitors are as happy at feeding time as the animals! Build a Zoo Cafeteria!
Quest.qm_zoo_5_dialog_hint: On nice days, the Zoo Picnic Area is a very popular family destination!
Quest.qm_zoo_5_intro: That reminds me! I think it would be terrific to put a Picnic Area in your Zoo! Let's do it!
Quest.qm_zoo_5_epilogue_message: The Jungle Animals are very happy! And it's a growing attraction for {cityname} citizens and visitors!
Quest.qm_cincodemayo_1_dialog_finish: Neato! your Cinco de Mayo party is going to be a blast! Share your plans with friends!
Quest.qm_cincodemayo_1_intro_title: Gosh! I Love Cinco de Mayo!
Quest.qm_cincodemayo_1_intro: What do you say we throw a big party with festive food and music?
Quest.qm_cincodemayo_2_task1_hint: HINT: Mariachi Band can be found in your Inventory.
Quest.qm_cincodemayo_2_task2_hint: HINT: Flags can be found under Decorations.
Quest.qm_cincodemayo_2_dialog_hint: You should be able to find the Mariachi Band in your inventory! Stop by my city for a Taqueria visit or two!
Quest.qm_cincodemayo_2_dialog_header: Arrange for the band, decorations, and food!
Quest.qm_cincodemayo_2_intro: You're doing a swell job of getting your Cinco de Mayo party in gear. Just a few more things to do!
Quest.qux_tacotruck_hint: You must complete the Cinco de Mayo Questline to unlock this!
Quest.s_movie_star1_task2_hint: HINT: Television Tower can be found under Community Building.
Quest.s_movie_star1_dialog_finish: Neato! Your preparations for Bella Bennett's visit are off to a super start! Tell friends!
Quest.s_movie_star1_dialog_header: Get ready for Bella Bennett's arrival!
Quest.s_movie_star2_task1: Collect from any 40 Businesses in your city
Quest.s_movie_star2_task3: Get one pair of Boots (Designer Collection)
Quest.s_movie_star2_task3_hint: HINT: Collect from handbag, sunglass, and shoe stores.
Quest.s_movie_star2_dialog_finish: Miss Bennett says shopping in your city is "as chic as Hollywood!" Share the glitzy news!
Quest.s_movie_star2_dialog_header: Send the movie star on a shopping spree!
Quest.s_movie_star2_intro: But shopping with a movie star is a different animal! I'm sure she has fabulous, expensive taste!
Quest.s_movie_star3_dialog_hint: I hear movie stars are super picky about their food! Andre's meal has to shine!
Quest.s_movie_star3_dialog_header: Find the ingredients for Andre's dinner recipe!
Quest.s_movie_star5_task1_hint: HINT: Frog Pond will be in Decorations after finishing the Star in the City goal.
Quest.s_movie_star5_task3: Visit 15 neighbors and tell them the news!
Quest.s_movie_star5_dialog_hint: When you see your city on the big screen, you'll know it was worth it!
Quest.s_movie_star5_dialog_finish: Yay! Your city's ready for its starring role in the new movie! Shoot the news to friends!
Quest.s_movie_star1_epilogue_message: Your city was an exciting location for my film to take place! I love the pond!
Quest.s_movie_star2_epilogue_message: Bella, you can shoot a movie in our city any time you want to!
Quest.qux_artichoke_hint: You must complete the Movie Star Quest before you can plant these.
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest1_dialog_hint: Folks love to try food of all kinds! Make sure it's fresh and plentiful!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest1_dialog_finish: Your International Food Festival is off to a delicious start! Friends should prepare too!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest1_dialog_header: Help Rita prepare for the International Food Festival!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest1_intro: I had a bountiful harvest this year! What do you say we have an International Food Festival?
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest2_task1: Collect 5 times from any Bakery in your city
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest2_task2: Collect 3 times from any French Restaurant in your city
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest2_dialog_finish: We've created some marvelous international recipes together! Friends should hear about it!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest3_task3: Collect from any French Restaurant 3 times
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest3_dialog_finish: Brilliant! You've earned my support for the International Food Festival! Inform friends!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest3_intro: Your International Food Festival will be superb for tourism! Let's be sure everyone knows about it.
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest4_task2: Collect from any 5 Greek Restaurants in your city
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest4_task3: Send Tour Busses to 4 Neighbor's Diners
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest4_dialog_hint: My pigeons eat every kind of Greek food except anything made with chicken!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest4_dialog_finish: My pigeons are cooing nonstop about the Greek cuisine at your Festival! Spread the news!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest4_dialog_header: Get the Greek food cooking for the Festival!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest4_intro: My pigeons and I heard that Greek food will be served at your International Food Festival! Delish!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest5_dialog_hint: Restaurants will be more popular than ever at the International Food Festival!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest5_dialog_finish: Fresh food and fun! What a perfect recipe for your International Food Festival! Tell all!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest5_intro: Be a sweetheart and help me with some last minute chores for the International Food Festival!
Quest.qux_thairestaurant_hint: Complete the PIGEONS FEST! quest to unlock.
Quest.qux_greekrestaurant_hint: Complete the FESTIVAL RECIPES! quest to unlock.
Quest.qm_promo_kungfupanda_intro: If you build a Drive-In Movie Theater in your city, I'll come see "Kung Fu Panda 2" there!
Quest.qm_promo_kungfupanda_task2: Complete the Kung Fu Panda 2 Collection, trade-in, and place the Po statue reward
Quest.qm_promo_kungfupanda_dialog_hint: Gosh! You only have until May 31st to trade in the collection for your very own Po statue!
Quest.qm_promo_kungfupanda_dialog_finish: Yay! You built a Drive-In Theater and completed the Kung Fu Panda 2 Collection! Let your friends know about it!
Quest.qm_upgrade_neighborBUS_bakery_intro: Help your neighbors upgrade their Bakery by sending Tour Buses. They'll do the same in return!
Quest.qm_upgrade_neighborBUS_bakery_dialog_hin: Any Tour Bus you send counts towards your Neighbor's next Upgrade!
Quest.qm_upgrade_neighborBUS_bakery_dialog_fin: Your neighbors thank you for your help with upgrading their Bakery! Tell friends!
Quest.qm_bridge_1_task1_hint: HINT: Expand to the river to place the bridge.
Quest.qm_bridge_1_dialog_finish: Everything appears to be in place to build your new Bridge. Tell friends it's happening.
Quest.qm_bridge_2_intro: If you triumph by building your Bridge over the River, I'll put down a free expansion. This is big!
Quest.qm_bridge_2_dialog_hint: With a finished Bridge and another expansion, your City is poised for spectacular growth.
Quest.qm_bridge_2_dialog_finish: This is historic! Your Bridge now spans both sides of the River. Invite friends to share your accomplishment.
Quest.qm_bridge_3_newsContent: Citizens celebrate crossing with big fireworks display.
Quest.qm_bridge_4_intro: I'd like you to promote the new Bridge with Flyers to get things rolling across the River!
Quest.qm_bridge_4_dialog_hint: Citizens will be anxious to check out the new neighborhood. Get the word out!
Quest.qm_bridge_5_dialog_header: Open a new business across the Bridge.
Quest.qm_bridge_5_dialog_finish: I knew if you built new businesses, people would come. Share your newfound success.
Quest.qm_bridges5_epilogue_message: My tourist business is expanding according to plan. Hotels will be my next big thing.
Quest.qm_storage_dau_dialog_hint: Time's a wastin'! I have freight trains on track to leave the station now! Reward: Cargo Shed
Quest.qm_storage_dau_dialog_header: Get the Goods by midnight on Tuesday May 31st.
Quest.qf_mall_construction_intro: You can imagine how excited I was when I heard you're opening a new Mall in your city!
Quest.qf_mall_construction_dialog_header: Put Businesses inside your Mall to maximize payouts!
Quest.qf_mall_construction2_intro: How about adding a Mall Sign and another store to enhance the shopping experience.
Quest.qf_mall_construction2_dialog_finish: Your Mall is on its way to becoming a major shopping destination! Tell your friends!
Quest.qf_mall_construction3_dialog_finish: I learned a lot by touring my friend's Malls. Did you? Tell your friends to tour too.
Quest.qf_mall_construction4_dialog_header: The more people shop the more cash they need!
Quest.qf_mall_construction4_dialog_hint: Fill a floor of your Mall and a mystery business may move in!
Quest.qf_mall_construction4_dialog_finish: Shopper satisfaction is up with the extra Mall parking and ATM! Share your development secrets!
Quest.qf_mall_construction5_intro: With so many people visiting your Mall every day, it's smart to have security on hand!
Quest.qf_mall_construction5_dialog_header: Put your Mall security on the beat.
Quest.qf_mall_construction5_dialog_hint: With a Rent-A-Cop on the beat, your shoppers will spend more time at the Mall!
Quest.qf_mall_construction5_dialog_finish: Your Mall shoppers are thankful you have their safety in mind. Suggest friends get security!
Quest.qf_mall_construction5_epilogue_message: Your Mall has it all! Each time you Collect from your Mall you have a chance to earn a Mystery Store!
Quest.qf_mall2_construction_task3: Click on 10 hearts in your friends Cities
Quest.qf_mall2_construction_dialog_hint: Click on your first mall to begin upgrading it!
Quest.qf_mall2_construction_dialog_finish: You can find your 2nd mall in your inventory! Place it today to save on space!
Quest.qf_mall2_construction2_dialog_hint: Your second mall comes with 2 free spots for your businesses!
Quest.qf_mall2_construction2_dialog_finish: I can't wait for more stores to open in your new Mall! Friends should open their own malls!
Quest.spring_party_quest_dialog_hint: Our party lasts just to 6/21! Help us plan and get a Wildflower Hill decoration!
Quest.spring_party_quest_dialog_header: Lend a hand to make the Spring Party fly high!
Quest.spring_party_quest_intro: The pigeons and I love Spring! So here's the scoop: We're throwing a three-day only party!
Quest.qm_boat_race_intro: Dan may sail a big cruise ship, but I'm the real sea captain. I've challenged him to a Boat Race!
Quest.qm_boat_race_dialog_hint: This Boat Race will settle up who fares better on the high seas.
Quest.qm_boat_race_dialog_finish: May the best captain win the Boat Race. That's me. Dan is cruisin' for losin'!
Quest.qm_boat_race2_intro: There's a ton of chores to get my boat in shipshape. I'm making you first mate on my winning crew!
Quest.qm_boat_race2_dialog_header: Get Rusty and his boat ready for the race.
Quest.qm_boat_race2_dialog_hint: To win the Boat Race all I need is: A worthy ship, dedicated crew and smarts.
Quest.qm_boat_race2_dialog_finish: Alrighty mate! We're on our way to winning the Boat Race.
Quest.qm_boat_race3_intro: It's gonna be me! I'm going into serious training by getting familiar with the sea, and it's food.
Quest.qm_boat_race3_dialog_header: Get Rusty's referee regimen on the right track.
Quest.qm_boat_race3_task2: Have 2 Crabs from the Surf and Turf Collection
Quest.qm_boat_race3_task3: Have 1 Lobster from the Surf and Turf Collection
Quest.qm_boat_race3_dialog_hint: Collect from your Seafood Restaurant or Tower Eats to get Crab and Lobster
Quest.qm_boat_race3_dialog_finish: My referee training is right on track. Tell friends that Charlie is ready to ref.
Quest.qm_boat_race4_intro: Dan's spreadin' rumors that he's in it to win it. I'll be waving him goodbye soon after we launch.
Quest.qm_boat_race4_dialog_header: Today's the big day. Get Rusty ready!
Quest.qm_boat_race4_task1: Send and Receive 20 San Francisco Supply Boats
Quest.qm_boat_race4_task3: Have 2 Sports Drinks from the Fitness collection
Quest.qm_boat_race4_dialog_hint: Collect from any Bike Shop or Sports Store to get Sports Drinks
Quest.qm_boat_race4_dialog_finish: During the race we found a new shipping route. Are your friends on-board?
Quest.qm_boat_race5_intro: Our off-the-charts navigation could have won one of us the race, if we didn't decide to go ashore!
Quest.qm_boat_race5_dialog_hint: Let's see the sites and gather a few authentic Chinese Kites!
Quest.qm_boat_race5_dialog_finish: You never know who your friends are until you find them - in China! Tell your friends.
Quest.qm_boat_race5_epilogue_message: Thanks for the kind words Rusty. It cost me the race, but I won a new seafaring friend!
Quest.qux_spinach_hint: Complete the RUSTY'S CHALLENGE quest to unlock.
Quest.qux_ship_junkboat_hint: Complete the CRUISE CONTROL quest to unlock.
Quest.qux_storagepier_hint: Complete the NEW FRIENDS IN CHINA quest to unlock.
Quest.qux_boatrace_shipping_hint: Complete the READY? SET? RACE! quest to unlock.
Quest.qf_ticket_booth_intro: Place a Ticket Booth in {cityname} and start collecting tickets for the upcoming Carnival.
Quest.qf_ticket_booth_dialog_hint: Collect Tickets from the Ticket Booth, for the upcoming Carnival in {cityname}.
Quest.qf_ticket_booth_dialog_finish: Fantastic! Now you can start collecting tickets for the Street Carnival coming soon.
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_intro: Man, I love the 4th of July!  It's almost as fun as coaching!
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_task2_hint: HINT: Harvest Strawberry crops to get collection items
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_task3_hint: HINT: Ask your friends for them!
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_dialog_finish: There's no "I" in Team. But there's one in Ice Cream!
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_2_task1_hint: HINT: Check the Businesses Build menu for your newly-unlocked Ice Cream Shop!
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_2_dialog_hint: You know, {cityname} deserves a Liberty Bell.  And a championship!
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_2_dialog_finish: We need to eat before the fireworks show! BBQ on 3! Ready! Break!
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_3_dialog_header: Join Jack's team and help him with his BBQ!
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_3_task2: Send 30 Tour Busses To Burger Joints
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_3_task2_hint: HINT: Click on Burger Joints in your Neighbor's Cities
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_3_dialog_hint: I'm about to explode! Speaking of explosions, let's go see some fireworks!
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_3_dialog_finish: What's for dessert? Oh yeah! Sue's Fireworks Show!
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_4_intro: I'm here to make sure {cityname} has a safe and sane Fireworks Celebration.
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_4_dialog_header: Safety First! Fun Second! More Fun Third! July Fourth!
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_4_task1: Collect from an Emergency Clinic 5 Times
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_4_task2_hint: HINT: Any fireworks stand in your city will do!
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_4_dialog_hint: Don't you wish your city had a fireworks store?! Then build one!
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_4_dialog_finish: We did it! And with all fingers intact!
Quest.qux_chinesefireworks_hint: Complete the FOURTH OF JULY FEVER: RED, WHITE, & BBQ quest to unlock.
Quest.qux_bbqrestaurant_hint: Complete the FOURTH OF JULY FEVER: LIGHT THE FUSE quest to unlock.
Quest.qm_marathonTimed1_task1_hint: It is time to witness greatness
Quest.qm_marathonTimed1_dialog_finish: What a blast!  It was close all the way to the finish. But I did it, the trophies mine!
Quest.qm_marathonTimed1_dialog_header: Before I get to the starting line, I need to hydrate.  Gotta fuel up before I run laps around these amateurs.
Quest.qm_marathonTimed1_intro: That gold medal is mine!  I've been training for weeks and I'm running on all cylinders! Here comes Courtney Flex!
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_intro: The pigeons have had this street carnival circled on their calendar for months. And yes, my pigeons use a calendar.
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_task1_hint: Find the best place for the carnival!
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_task2_hint: Finish your carnival before people arrive!
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_dialog_finish: Alright, time to have some fun.  But remember, it's all fun and games until someone loses a beak.
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_2_dialog_header: I better feed the pigeons before this carnival turns into a horror film.
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_2_task2: Buy and Place any item from the Carnival in your City
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_2_dialog_finish: They say cheaters never win.  But, in my experience, they sometimes do.
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_3_dialog_header: Looks like the pigeons want cotton candy now. I guess that makes me their sugar mama.
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_3_task1_hint: Visit neighbors to send Tour Buses!
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_4_intro: I haven't had this much fun since I cut my own hair!
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_4_dialog_header: Those birds have gone overboard and now they need me to play doctor.  Luckily, I have a PhD in Pigeonomics.
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_4_dialog_finish: Well, now I know why they say, "Don't bring birds to a carnival."  Actually, I don't think anyone says that.
Quest.qux_shootinggallery_hint: Complete the STREET CARNIVAL quest to unlock.
Quest.qux_cottoncandystand_hint: Complete the STREET CARNIVAL: SWEETEN THE DEAL quest to unlock.
Quest.qux_grillstand_hint: Complete the STREET CARNIVAL: STUFFED PIGEONS quest to unlock.
Quest.qm_green1_intro: You have one of the greatest cities on earth.  But now it's time to make it one of the greenest cities on earth!
Quest.qm_green1_task2: Get 25 Petitions for a Wind Farm
Quest.qm_green1_dialog_header: Nothing turns on a city like a renewable energy source!
Quest.qm_green2_intro: With the new Garden Shop, your citizens will reap what they sow!
Quest.qm_green2_dialog_finish: I consider myself a world class recyclist.  Let's see if you can keep up!
Quest.qm_green2_dialog_header: To go greener, you're going to have to dig deep!
Quest.qm_green3_intro: Let's get the Recycling Plant running smoothly.  I always like to say, "It's the gift that keeps on giving!"
Quest.qm_green3_dialog_finish: You've got the green light to keep going greener!  Your city needs a symbol of sustainability!
Quest.qm_green3_dialog_header: Lead by example and get your Eco-Friendly House in order!
Quest.qm_green4_intro: You're almost there!  You're close to having the most environmentally friendly cities in the world!
Quest.qux_recyclingplant_hint: Complete the NIP IT IN THE BUD quest to unlock.
Quest.qux_ecoskyscraper_hint: Complete the THE SKY'S THE LIMIT quest to unlock.
Quest.qm_neighbor_vists_hearts_intro: You can now ask neighbors for specific help in your City. Place hearts so your neighbors know what you need!
Quest.qm_neighbor_vists_hearts_dialog_header: Now you and your neighbors can tell each other exactly where you want help. Have a heart and help out.
Quest.qm_neighbor_vists_hearts_task1_hint: Click on the arrow button to select the heart tool. Level up your reputation to get more hearts!
Quest.qm_neighbor_vists_hearts_task2_hint: Visit City Sam to help you progress on this task!
Quest.qm_neighbor_vists_hearts_dialog_finish: Helping out is the Neighborly thing to do.  Especially when they help you out too!
Quest.qf_crop_mastery_dialog_header: I know a thing er two about crop mastery. If you don't know yer way around a corn field, you ain't even close!
Quest.qf_crop_mastery_dialog_finish: Wowee! I ain't never seen anybody master a crop like that!  I ain't just butterin' you up, neither!
Quest.qm_bastille_intro: Bonjour! Bastille Day is upon us and we have a lot on our plate!  First up, let's cook up a parade for {cityname}!
Quest.qm_bastille_dialog_header: There's only one thing that's says 'French' than my souffle and that's a fresh Baguette!
Quest.qm_bastille_task1_hint: Find it in the Decorations section of the Build menu!
Quest.qm_bastille_task2_hint: Have a little tete a tete with your business owners
Quest.qm_bastille_dialog_finish: It's time to say bon voyage to the parade and prepare a patriotic feast!
Quest.qm_bastille_2_dialog_header: Before we commit a fashion faux pas, let's get the proper attire!
Quest.qm_bastille_2_task3: Collect from your French Cafe 5 times
Quest.qm_bastille_2_dialog_finish: Now that you have a place to bake your national treasures, let's send Bastille Day off with a bang!
Quest.qm_bastille_3_intro: Now it's time for the main course!  A magnifique firework show that will light up the beautiful {cityname} sky!
Quest.qm_bastille_3_task3: Send 25 Tour Buses to your neighbors French Restaurants
Quest.qm_bastille_3_dialog_finish: Voila! Every course turned out perfect this Bastille Day!  Excusez moi for ever doubting you!
Quest.qux_frenchcafe_hint: Complete the BASTILLE DAY: VIVE LA FRANCE quest to unlock.
Quest.qux_frenchgarden_hint: Complete the BASTILLE DAY: FIREWORKS DU JOUR quest to unlock.
Quest.qf_tikisocial_intro: Wonder what you need to do to get one step closer to the Eiffel Tower Wonder? You need to build this one of a kind restaurant!
Quest.qf_tikisocial_dialog_header: Complete the Tonga Tower, CityVille's most amazing restaurant, to get one step closer to unlocking the Eiffel Tower!
Quest.qf_casinosocial_dialog_header: Complete the French Riviera Casino, CityVille's most amazing casino, to get one step closer to unlocking the Eiffel Tower!
Quest.qf_casinosocial_task1_hint: To finish your French Riviera Casino, click the place button and start building
Quest.qf_hotels_intro: In life, luxury is a necessity. And so is a continental breakfast!
Quest.qf_hotels_dialog_finish: Let's raise the bar.  The mini bar, that is!
Quest.qf_hotels_2_intro: Everything has a price.  Even the tiny shampoo bottles!
Quest.qf_hotels_2_dialog_hint: Create a super resort by placing businesses into the green circle around your hotel.
Quest.qf_hotels_2_dialog_finish: The valet better not scratch my car!
Quest.qf_hotels_3_intro: People say you can't buy happiness. But you can sure as heck try!
Quest.qf_hotels_3_dialog_header: We're setting our course as the best hotel in {cityname}!
Quest.qf_hotels_3_dialog_hint: Make sure your businesses are stocked and ready for all the waves of shopaholic tourists!
Quest.qf_hotels_3_dialog_finish: Now that we're up and running, let's drop our anchor at some other hotels!
Quest.qf_hotels_4_intro: Even tycoons like me deserve a vacation!
Quest.qf_hotels_4_dialog_header: I'm checking out for a bit.  Go dump your baggage on some of your friends!
Quest.qf_hotels_4_task1: Check-in 3 times to any friends' hotels
Quest.qf_hotels_4_dialog_title: Nothing like recharging the ol' battery!
Quest.qf_hotels_5_intro: Treat your guests how you want to be treated.  But treat me better!
Quest.qf_hotels_5_dialog_header: What do you give the man who has everything?  Well, what do ya got?!
Quest.qf_hotels_5_task1: Grant someone VIP access to your hotel
Quest.qf_hotels_5_dialog_hint: Go to your hotels guest list to upgrade friends to VIP status!
Quest.qf_hotels_5_dialog_finish: Nice work.  Now, if you'll excuse me, I'll be at the pool.
Quest.qm_odd_day_zoo_dialog_header: I can't wait to see the Ostriches at the {cityname} Zoo. They're like tall Pigeons that can't fly!
Quest.qm_odd_day_zoo_task1_hint: If you don't have a Jungle Habitat, it would make a great addition!
Quest.qm_odd_day_zoo_task3: Collect from your Zoo Cafeteria 3 times
Quest.qm_odd_day_zoo_task3_hint: I wonder if these animals are eyeing me or my food? We better get movin'!
Quest.qm_odd_day_zoo_dialog_finish: The Ostriches are just darling! I could swear one in particular was trying to tell me something.
Quest.qm_odd_day_zoo2_intro: The {cityname} could really use some help raising money.
Quest.qm_odd_day_zoo2_task2_hint: If you don't have a Savannah Habitat, it would make a great addition!
Quest.qm_odd_day_zoo3_intro: Goodness, an Ostrich escaped and followed me home! How peculiarly fantastic!
Quest.qm_odd_day_zoo3_task1_hint: You can find the Ostrich Buddies in your inventory
Quest.qm_odd_day_zoo3_task2_hint: I hope I've planted enough corn to feed such a large bird.
Quest.qm_odd_day_zoo3_task3_hint: Which came first? The Ostrich or the egg?
Quest.qm_odd_day_zoo3_dialog_finish: I love my new Ostrich family and their beautiful home. Now where did my beloved pigeons go?
Quest.qm_odd_day_rusty_intro: Full steam ahead to the {cityname} Aquarium, for a day of wonder, excitement, and salt water!
Quest.qm_odd_day_rusty_dialog_header: Something fishy is going down at the {cityname} Aquarium, and it's not just my anchovy pizza.
Quest.qm_odd_day_rusty_task1_hint: All cities need Aquariums. Your friends can help you complete it faster!
Quest.qm_odd_day_rusty_dialog_finish: While I'm at the Aquarium I should say "hi" to my old shipmate, Max.
Quest.qm_odd_day_rusty2_intro: Max told me of a strange Sea Creature he's named Bessie that has been spotted off the coast. I shall set sail at first light!
Quest.qm_odd_day_rusty2_dialog_header: Goodbye dry land! I'll see you only after I find the mysterious Sea Creature!
Quest.qm_odd_day_rusty2_task1_hint: Last sightings had Bessie tracking towards the Orient
Quest.qm_odd_day_rusty2_task2_hint: Could Bessie have made it onto a container vessel? I better check the train cargo!
Quest.qm_odd_day_rusty3_intro: Bessie has the most perfect table manners. It's time to introduce everybody to our new guest!
Quest.qm_odd_day_rusty3_dialog_header: It's hot outside and what better way to cool off than to take a dip in fresh water?
Quest.qm_odd_day_rusty3_task1_hint: Check your inventory for the Bessie in a Pool
Quest.qm_odd_day_rusty3_task3_hint: Did you know cranberries have small air-pockets that cause them to float in water?
Quest.qm_odd_day_rusty3_dialog_finish: Bessie and I are getting along famously. We do see eye-to-eye.
Quest.qm_odd_day_rusty4_intro: I've taken quite a liking to Bessie. I'm going to clear out a permanent space for her to call her own.
Quest.qm_odd_day_rusty4_dialog_header: I've lost my marbles. Literally, all my shiny objects have been going missing!
Quest.qm_odd_day_rusty4_task1_hint: I'll get these cops on the beat
Quest.qm_odd_day_rusty4_task2_hint: I'll need more donuts for the cops
Quest.qm_odd_day_rusty4_dialog_finish: It was Bessie that took all my shiny objects! Looks like she's gonna be quite the prankster!
Quest.qm_landmark_sailboat_hotel_intro: Get ready for a challenge! Unlock the Sailboat Hotel for incredible payouts and to begin unlocking the Eiffel Tower!
Quest.qm_landmark_sailboat_hotel_task1_hint: Drop your anchor. To get started, click "Place".
Quest.qm_landmark_sailboat_hotel_dialog_finish: This hotel's close to setting sail! Take over for a while, captain. I'm gonna go get three sheets to the wind.
Quest.qt_tourdecity_intro: Bonjour! I'm cooking up a grand bike race for {cityname}! But first, we need to gather all the right ingredients!
Quest.qt_tourdecity_dialog_header: Just like my restaurant needs a staff and patrons, our race needs a crew and spectators! Let's whip some up!
Quest.qt_tourdecity_task1: Ask 20 friends to join your Bike Crew
Quest.qt_tourdecity_task2_hint: You need to tell neighbors about the bike race
Quest.qt_tourdecity_task3: Collect from Water Bottling Plant 2 times
Quest.qt_tourdecity_dialog_finish: Ooh la la!  What a glorious ride! You look tres bien in that yellow jersey, if you don't mind me saying so!
Quest.qux_cycliststatue_hint: Unlocked by getting 2nd place or higher in the LEADER OF THE PACK Quest!
Quest.qm_attractionTimed_task1_hint: You can find the Go Kart Attraction under Businesses in the Build Menu
Quest.qm_attractionTimed_task2_hint: Click on your Go Kart Attraction to open it
Quest.qm_attractionTimed_task3_hint: Tourists spend more money at Attractions than regular people do
Quest.qm_attractionTimed_dialog_finish: Wow, that was fun!  I feel like I did pretty well out there.  I just hope that helmet didn't mess up my hair!
Quest.qm_attractionTimed_dialog_header: After sitting in traffic each day, I'd love to be able to step on the gas in a go kart!  The faster, the better!
Quest.qf_sandcastle_intro: Ever since I was a kid, I've been quite the sand castle builder.  Let's see how you stack up against this small town girl!
Quest.qf_sandcastle_dialog_header: Well, I see you've got your shovel and your pail.  Let's draw a line in the sand and see what you can do!
Quest.qf_sandcastle_dialog_finish: You're just a regular sand castle architect!  I need to get my head out of the sand and learn your technique!
Quest.qf_beach_carnival_quest_intro: Now that my career has taken off, I want to make a movie about one of my passions. It's called 'The Wave Whisperer'!
Quest.qf_beach_carnival_quest_dialog_header: I want this film to be really authentic. So, l'm going to open my very own Surf 'n Shop to get a feel for the world.
Quest.qf_beach_carnival_quest_dialog_finish: The Surf 'n Shop looks great! Let's go find some props on the beach to decorate it with!
Quest.qf_beach_carnival_quest_2_intro: I'm a method actor so I need to walk in my character's shoes. Or in this case, sandals!
Quest.qf_beach_carnival_quest_2_dialog_header: Let's hit the beach and see what we can find. I hope the paparazzi doesn't follow me!
Quest.qf_beach_carnival_quest_2_task2: Buy and Place any item from the Surf 'n Shop in your City
Quest.qf_beach_carnival_quest_2_dialog_finish: It's so exciting how everything's coming together! I can't wait to start filming 'The Wave Whisperer'!
Quest.qf_beach_carnival_quest_3_intro: I should be rehearsing my lines but I need to go back to the beach. Where's my assistant when I need her?!
Quest.qf_beach_carnival_quest_3_dialog_finish: Now that I have my Oscar back, it's time to go out and try to win another one!
Quest.qf_beach_carnival_quest_4_dialog_header: Since I forgot to bring my trailer, I guess I'll check into a hotel and get some rest. I need my beauty sleep!
Quest.qt_outdoorhike_intro: There are a lotta fun things to do in the outdoors, that's fer sure.  Come see why they call me a lumberjack of all trades!
Quest.qt_outdoorhike_dialog_header: Well, fluff my flannel!  It sure is a beautiful day out there.  Whaddya say we go backpackin', eh?!
Quest.qt_outdoorhike_task1_hint: I go through a lot of boots when I hike
Quest.qt_outdoorhike_task3: Have 12 Items from the Fast Food Collection
Quest.qt_outdoorhike_dialog_finish: Wow, look at that there view!  It might even bring a tear to my eyes if I wasn't so darn manly.
Quest.qux_redwoodtrees_hint: You need to Earn 2nd Place or higher in TAKE A HIKE to unlock this!
Quest.qf_dam_1_dialog_hint: Use the dam's hydroelectric power to increase your energy cap to 37.
Quest.qf_dam_1_intro: Build this dam to increase your energy bar cap!
Quest.qf_dam_2_dialog_header: Get your Dam up and running to increase your energy cap!

Quest.qf_dam_2_dialog_finish: Congratulations! Now you can light up your city with this Lamp Store.
Quest.qf_dam_3_dialog_hint: Now that your dam is up and running, check your energy bar to see if you are at a higher energy cap.
Quest.qf_dam_3_dialog_finish: Just what every city needs... a Turbine Statue!
Quest.qf_dam_4_dialog_hint: Great job! you're so close to having dam in peak condition.
Quest.qf_dam_4_dialog_finish: Congratulations! You're on your way to becoming a Dam expert.
Quest.qm_vacation_1_intro: Time for a Stumpford family tradition!  Let's load up the station wagon and drive each other crazy! Whaddya say, kids?!
Quest.qm_vacation_1_dialog_header: Honey, I say we hit the road and head to Hidden Lake!  No need for maps or GPS.  My sense of direction is flawless.
Quest.qm_vacation_1_dialog_finish: Looks like we're ready to go!  Kids, make sure you go to the bathroom.  The first rest stop is 10 hours away!
Quest.qm_vacation_2_intro: Sorry, honey.  Gotta make a pit stop.  This is a once in a lifetime opportunity!  Get a photo of me with the huge rubber band ball!
Quest.qm_vacation_2_dialog_header: This is the best meal I've ever eaten!  But it's nothing compared to your home cooked meals, honey.  Honey?!
Quest.qm_vacation_3_dialog_hint: This is quest part 3 of 4.  Complete all for the grand prize: Hidden Lake!
Quest.qm_vacation_3_task1_hint: The Fitness Collection can be collected from the Bicycle Shop and other Sports stores
Quest.qm_vacation_3_task3_hint: Because I said so, kids.  You can find tents under Decorations in the Build Menu.
Quest.qm_vacation_3_dialog_finish: Okay, let's get some shut eye.  We have a big day of canoeing and family bonding ahead of us.  G'night, honey!
Quest.qm_vacation_4_dialog_header: I see something!  Ooh, and I feel something!  Something itchy.  That's just great!  I'm standing in poison ivy!
Quest.qm_vacation_4_dialog_hint: This is quest part 4 of 4.  Complete it for the grand prize: Hidden Lake!
Quest.qm_vacation_4_dialog_finish: Well, Stumpfords, this is a vacation we won't soon forget.  And I have the rash to prove it!
Quest.qm_beach_fun_intro: Golly, this is the hottest summer we've had in years! I'm gonna take a break from work and head fer the waves!
Quest.qm_beach_fun_dialog_header: Man, that sun means business! If I'm not careful, I'm gonna be redder than a tomato!
Quest.qm_beach_fun_task2_hint: I love drinks with umbrellas in 'em. Find the beach hut in the residence build menu
Quest.qf_beach_fun_questLootDrop_intro: The tourists on my cruise ship like to have fun off shore and on! So, I'm going to scope out some seaside shenanigans!
Quest.qf_beach_fun_questLootDrop_dialog_header: They're going to love taking a stroll down the boardwalk! There are so many cool shops!
Quest.qf_beach_fun_questLootDrop_dialog_finish: I think the tourists are going to love this beach so much that they're going to refuse to get back on my ship!
Quest.qm_beach_fun3_dialog_header: Something smells fishy about all this.  Hey, that's it! I'll make 'em wish they'd never left those ships!
Quest.qm_beach_fun3_dialog_finish: Looks like most of 'em took the bait! It's times like these that I wish I had a shark costume.
Quest.qm_beach_fun4_task2: Collect from Jet Ski Shop 5 times
Quest.qm_beach_fun4_task3_hint: Pigeons don't use beach chairs! Check the decoration build menu for a fish fountain
Quest.qux_marina_hint: You need to complete the POOL PIGEON quest to unlock this!
Quest.qt_outdoorbirding_intro: When I'm out in the forest, I like to do a little bird watchin'. But you have to have eyes like a hawk to spot 'em!
Quest.qt_outdoorbirding_dialog_header: Looks like some of these birds flew the coop! I guess we're going to have to find out where they're hiding.
Quest.qt_outdoorbirding_task2_hint: Check for birds at your neighbors' places
Quest.qt_outdoorbirding_task3_hint: Birds like to hang out in Corn Fields
Quest.qm_remodeling_intro: They say that variety is the spice of life. The same idea applies to architecture! So, let's do some remodeling!
Quest.qm_remodeling_task1_hint: With this building, you can remodel residences and upgrade their stats
Quest.qm_remodeling_dialog_finish: You have a great eye for decorating. Maybe you could give me some advice on what color to paint my own house!

Quest.qt_outdoorrafting_intro: It’s time for me to trade in my ax for an oar!  Whaddya say we hit the river and do some white water rafting, eh?!
Quest.qt_outdoorrafting_dialog_header: Before we jump in the raft, we need to make sure we’re good and ready to tackle this raging river!
Quest.qt_outdoorrafting_dialog_finish: We logged a lot of hours on the river today, that’s fer sure!  I’m gonna sleep like a bearded baby tonight!
Quest.qf_enrique_1_intro: {cityname}, your city is my favorite stop on the Euphoria tour. Are you ready for the concert?
Quest.qf_enrique_1_task2_hint: Click Enrique's Euphoria Arena to play a concert!
Quest.qf_enrique_1_task3_hint: Collection items drop by collecting from Enrique's Euphoria Arena.
Quest.qf_enrique_1_dialog_finish: Wow, this city really knows how to rock! I’m going to have to come here on my next tour!

Quest.qf_enrique_2_dialog_header: This city's fans have made me feel at home the whole time I've been here. Maybe I should move here.
Quest.qf_enrique_2_task2: Have Enrique's Speedboat in your city
Quest.qf_enrique_2_task3_hint: Raise money to bring me back
Quest.qf_enrique_2_dialog_finish: I guess I should head back out on my Euphoria tour. This experience has been amazing!
