Quest.q_cokezero_dialog_header: Not only will the Coca-Cola Zero Bottling Plant quench your thirst, it'll also help your city's economy!
Quest.q_elder2_family_visit_1_intro: I tend to make a good first impression on all of my patients. But I'm still waiting for Louise's Dad to warm up to me!
Quest.q_elder2_family_visit_1_dialog_finish: Wow, Louise's parents sure do have a lot of energy!
Quest.q_elder2_family_visit_2_dialog_header: Before I went to med school, I thought about becoming a chef! Let's get cooking!
Quest.q_elder2_family_visit_2_task1_hint: Louise gave me a secret recipe to try
Quest.q_elder2_family_visit_2_task2_hint: Collect from the City Supermarket, Produce Paradise, or Corner Store
Quest.q_elder2_family_visit_2_dialog_finish: Well, it looks like Louise and her mother are going out tomorrow. I better plan something for Dad!
Quest.q_elder2_family_visit_3_dialog_header: You can't go wrong with a manicure! We're going to have such a relaxing day!
Quest.q_elder2_family_visit_3_task1_hint: I'll bet they're not having as much fun as we are
Quest.q_elder2_family_visit_4_dialog_header: Every guy likes sports, right?! Well, except for me. But I can pretend! Let's play ball!
Quest.q_elder2_family_visit_4_task3: Collect from the Executive Driving Range 3 times
Quest.q_elder2_family_visit_4_task3_hint: Never bet against a doctor in golf
Quest.q_elder3_cookie_baking_1_dialog_header: The key to the perfect cookie is having the right recipe! And I have the recipe for success!
Quest.q_elder3_cookie_baking_1_task2: Send 25 Tour Buses to Neighboring Bakeries
Quest.q_elder3_cookie_baking_1_dialog_finish: I talked to Lorenzo and he loves my idea! This is history in the baking!
Quest.q_elder3_cookie_baking_2_task2_hint: Try City Supermarket, Produce Paradise, or Corner Store
Quest.q_elder3_cookie_baking_2_dialog_finish: A baker is only as good as his ingredients! And I've got the best money can buy!
Quest.q_elder3_cookie_baking_3_intro: Before we start the holiday cookie bake-off, let's shake hands. May the best baker win!
Quest.q_elder3_cookie_baking_3_task1: Collect 12 Bags of Flour from Friends
Quest.q_elder3_cookie_baking_3_task2_hint: Andre, get your family to help, too
Quest.q_elder3_cookie_baking_3_dialog_finish: It looks like Lorenzo's team won the bake-off but I look forward to a rematch next holiday season!
Quest.q_elder3_cookie_baking_4_task2_hint: Wow, we sold a ton of cookies
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_nature_1_mouseover_m: Get Mother Nature's vote and you'll get mine, too!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_nature_1_intro: Being Governor means taking care of not only your citizens but the plants and animals as well!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_nature_1_dialog_head: The more beautiful the city is, the happier its citizens will be! Let's put our flowers on display!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_nature_1_task1_hint: Complete it to increase your population allowed by 3,750
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_nature_1_dialog_hint: This is quest part 1 of 3. Complete them all for 500 XP!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_nature_1_dialog_fini: Every city is going to wish it had a Conservatory like this! You're really growing on me!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_nature_2_mouseover_m: Help your citizens eat healthier and they just might keep you around!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_nature_2_dialog_head: Let's see if you're handy around the garden. Sometimes you have to do a little dirty work!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_nature_2_dialog_fini: There's nothing more satisfying than growing your own food. Your leadership style is very refreshing!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_nature_3_mouseover_m: Let's see if you can energize all the undecided voters!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_nature_3_intro: Being green and energy efficient are traits that could give you and your campaign a jolt!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_nature_3_dialog_head: Let's show the citizens that you're not only their friend but you're the planet's friend, too!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_nature_epilogue_mess: Good luck with the election! Being Governor is going to be second nature to you!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_student_1_dialog_hea: It's easy to get lost on this campus. Stick with me and maybe I'll show you the ropes...
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_student_1_task2: Collect from a University Student Center 2 times
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_student_1_dialog_hin: This is quest part 1 of 4. Complete them all for 500 XP!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_student_2_mouseover_: Take a break from class and show off your student body!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_student_2_intro: We like to study hard and party harder! Help my class and me go on an awesome trip while school's out!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_student_2_dialog_hin: This is quest part 2 of 4. Complete them all for 500 XP!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_student_2_dialog_fin: Man, that was awesome! You politicians really know how to party!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_student_3_mouseover_: Help us get internships and we'll help you get your dream job!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_student_3_task2_hint: Maybe I could be a meteorologist
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_student_3_dialog_hin: This is quest part 3 of 4. Complete them all for 500 XP!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_student_3_dialog_fin: Thanks for helping me get an internship! Maybe I can be someone's boss one day!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_student_4_mouseover_: Let's see how much you grow on the kids in agriculture school!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_student_4_intro: You need to plant yourself in the fertile minds of the agriculture school students!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_student_4_dialog_hin: This is quest part 4 of 4. Complete them all for 500 XP!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_student_4_dialog_fin: I have to hand it to you. You really impressed the kids at the agriculture school!
Quest.q_governor_run_student_epilogue_message: Good luck with the election! You've inspired me to change my major to political science!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_vampire_1_mouseover_: You'll have to use a few scare tactics if you want to get the Monster vote!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_vampire_1_dialog_hea: I'm going to take you under my wing and teach you how to make a ghoul of yourself!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_vampire_2_mouseover_: If anyone knows who has the brains for this job, it's a zombie!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_vampire_2_intro: Impress the walking dead and you'll be walking straight into the Governor's mansion in no time!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_vampire_2_dialog_hin: This is quest part 2 of 4 Complete them all for a Blood Mobile!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_vampire_3_mouseover_: The Governor's Race is neck and neck!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_vampire_3_intro: If you're going to win over the vampires, you're going to have to fight tooth and nail for their votes!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_vampire_3_task3: Collect from Pirate Ship Attraction 1 time
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_vampire_3_dialog_fin: You deserve to not only be governor, but you deserve to be immortalized forever! Where are you going?!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_vampire_4_mouseover_: Grab your broomstick and let's clean up this city!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_vampire_4_intro: The witches don't know which candidate they prefer. Which witch should we pitch to first?
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_vampire_4_dialog_hea: The witches won't easily be put under your spell. They want to get to know the real you.
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_vampire_4_dialog_hin: This is quest part 4 of 4 Complete it for a Blood Mobile!
Quest.q_governor_run_act2_vampire_4_dialog_fin: Did the witches scare you? You're speechless! That's not very becoming of a governor!
Quest.q_governor_run_vampire_epilogue_message: Good luck with the election! Take our advice and go knock 'em dead!
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_bella_1_intro: I'm not just a pretty face. I'm an entrepreneur, too! What I'd really like to do is launch my own lifestyle brand!
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_bella_1_task1_hint: Maybe I should live by the beach
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_bella_1_dialog_finis: I found a penthouse that is the perfect place for me to launch my music career! Thanks for your help!
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_bella_2_dialog_heade: My boyfriend, Vance, has been very vocal that my studio should be the best that money can buy!
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_bella_2_task1_hint: I'm going to order take out so I can keep working
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_bella_2_task2_hint: This penthouse is helping me focus
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_bella_2_task3_hint: I want all of my songs to be perfect
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_bella_2_dialog_finis: My recording studio is already finished! I can't wait to get in there and start my album!
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_bella_3_task1_hint: I'm can't wait to see my fans there
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_bella_3_task2_hint: I'm recording some promotional spots for you
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_bella_3_dialog_finis: All my fans are going to the polls for you on election day! But they still like me more, of course.
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_bella_4_dialog_heade: Let's open up the franchise headquarters for Bella B, the ultimate shopping experience for today's woman!
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_bella_4_task1_hint: I need to stock up Bella B for the opening
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_bella_4_task2_hint: Complete Salvador's Quest to get his Club!
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_bella_epilogue_messa: If governors have understudies, let me know! I'd be happy to take over for you!

Quest.q_governor_run_act3_salvador_1_task3_hin: Bella Bennett is making her singing debut

Quest.q_governor_run_act3_salvador_2_dialog_fi: The horse track was finished just in time! I've got people lining up down the street to get in this place!

Quest.q_governor_run_act3_vance_3_task2_hint: Complete the Raise The Stakes goal to receive Salvador's

Quest.q_governor_run_act3_vance_3_dialog_hint: This is quest part 3 of 4. Complete them all for Valor Mansion!
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_vance_4_dialog_heade: I feel that you can be a good Governor. But you'll need a strong council to be a great Governor.
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_vance_4_task2: Collect from City Hall, Court House, or Capitol Building 9 times
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_vance_4_task2_hint: I have a list of potential appointees for you
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_vance_4_task3_hint: Let's hold interviews at Valor Industries
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_vance_4_dialog_hint: This is quest part 4 of 4. Complete them all for Valor Mansion!
Quest.q_governor_run_act3_vance_4_dialog_finis: Now, that you have a great council by your side, tell us what you need. We answer to you now.
Quest.q_governor_run_family_1_dialog_header: We Stumpfords know how to have a good time. If you want to be Governor, you gotta know how to cut loose!
Quest.q_governor_run_family_1_task2: Collect from Executive Driving Range 1 time for Dad
Quest.q_governor_run_family_1_task2_hint: Find the Executive Driving Range in the Build Menu
Quest.q_governor_run_family_1_dialog_hint: This is quest part 1 of 3. Complete them all for a Mega Nail Salon!
Quest.q_governor_run_family_2_mouseover_messag: Be smart and listen to your voters! You might learn something!
Quest.q_governor_run_family_2_intro: I wasn't very good at school when I was young. And I'm even worse at school now that I'm out of it.
Quest.q_governor_run_family_2_dialog_header: I bet you got to this position by paying attention in school. Well, help us make our schools even better!
Quest.q_governor_run_family_2_task2_hint: Those were the best years of my life
Quest.q_governor_run_family_2_dialog_hint: This is quest part 2 of 3. Complete them all for a Mega Nail Salon!
Quest.q_governor_run_family_2_dialog_finish: I think you gave us all an education today in what it takes to be a great leader! Kids, say thank you!
Quest.q_governor_run_family_3_mouseover_messag: Put some polish on our city and we'll put you in the Governor's Mansion!
Quest.q_governor_run_family_3_dialog_hint: This is quest part 3 of 3. Complete them all for a Mega Nail Salon!
Quest.q_governor_run_family_3_dialog_finish: The city looks great! Kids, I don't know about you but your mother and I know who has our vote!
Quest.q_governor_run_family_3_epilogue_message: Good luck with the election! Don't forget to thank us in your acceptance speech!
Quest.q_governor_run_rita_1_mouseover_message: Let's see if you’re the cream of the crop!
Quest.q_governor_run_rita_1_intro: If you want my vote, you’re gonna have to give me a hand. A farm hand, that is!
Quest.q_governor_run_rita_1_dialog_header: Farmin's a tough job but it's rewardin'! So, roll up those sleeves and let’s get to work!
Quest.q_governor_run_rita_1_task1: Ask friends for 5 bags of Animal Feed
Quest.q_governor_run_rita_1_dialog_hint: This is quest part 1 of 3. Complete all for the grand prize: Mega Silo!
Quest.q_governor_run_rita_1_dialog_finish: Well, the farm’s lookin’ better already but what’s here today can be gone tomorrow. Fingers crossed!
Quest.q_governor_run_rita_2_mouseover_message: Get rid of these bugs and you've got my vote!
Quest.q_governor_run_rita_2_intro: Oh no! A big ol' swarm of locusts is headed toward the farm! I told ya we gotta be ready for anything!
Quest.q_governor_run_rita_2_dialog_header: A real leader knows how to handle all kinds of challenges. Well, it's yer time to shine!
Quest.q_governor_run_rita_2_task3_hint: Help your neighbors before the locusts get their crops
Quest.q_governor_run_rita_2_dialog_hint: This is quest part 2 of 3. Complete all for the grand prize: Mega Silo!
Quest.q_governor_run_rita_2_dialog_finish: I think I may need to spread the word to all my farmer friends about you! You're right at home on the farm!
Quest.q_governor_run_rita_3_intro: Now that my crops are safe from them pesky locusts, let's sell 'em! Gotta make a livin'!
Quest.q_governor_run_rita_3_task1_hint: Gotta have something to carry the fruit
Quest.q_governor_run_rita_3_task3_hint: Produce Paradise available in Build Menu
Quest.q_governor_run_rita_3_dialog_hint: This is quest part 3 of 3. Complete all for the grand prize: Mega Silo!
Quest.q_governor_run_rita_3_dialog_finish: You're proving to be quite the salesman! And I'm about sold on you! You sure as heck have my vote!
Quest.q_governor_run_toy_1_mouseover_message: Help me make some toys and I’ll help you make Governor!
Quest.q_governor_run_toy_2_intro: You’re getting the hang of this business! Let’s keep on marching until we reach the top of the toy world!
Quest.q_governor_run_toy_2_dialog_header: My daughter still sleeps with her childhood doll. And she’s a senior in college!
Quest.q_governor_run_toy_2_task1_hint: Why do kids love Toy Blocks so much?
Quest.q_governor_run_toy_2_task2_hint: Supply a Level 1 Toy Store 50 times
Quest.q_governor_run_toy_2_task3_hint: Hearts let your friends know where you need help
Quest.q_governor_run_toy_3_mouseover_message: It’s all fun and games until someone loses my vote!
Quest.q_governor_run_toy_3_intro: If you help me, then I’ll help you! I assure you that I am not toying with you.
Quest.q_governor_run_toy_3_dialog_header: All aboard! This toy train is leaving the station! Next stop, the bank!
Quest.q_governor_run_toymaker_epilogue_message: Good luck with the election! If you win, maybe I’ll name a doll after you!
Quest.q_greenhouse_intro: Your city has ripened into such a beautiful place! But there almost isn’t enough room for all your different crops!
Quest.q_greenhouse_dialog_header: Let’s give your city a greenhouse so you can save space and grow a lot of your crops in one place!
Quest.q_greenhouse_task2_hint: For short term crops (harvest in under 8 hours)
Quest.q_greenhouse_task3_hint: Isn’t it great to grow more crops at once?
Quest.q_greenhouse_dialog_finish: I’m so glad to see that you’re saving space and being environmentally friendly! Nice job!
Quest.q_greenhouse_dialog_hint: The Grain Elevator helps you store goods
Quest.q_greenhouse2_task2: Harvest a level 2 Grass Roots Greenhouse
Quest.q_greenhouse2_task2_hint: Upgrading gives us even better space savings for our crops!
Quest.q_greenhouse2_task3: Harvest 45 Alfalfa from a Grass Roots Greenhouse
Quest.q_greenhouse3_task2_hint: This is quite the growth spurt
Quest.q_greenhouse3_task3: Harvest 80 Brussell Sprouts from a Greenhouse
Quest.q_halloweenneighborhood_dialog_header: Do you mind if my friend and his horse move in? He doesn't have a hood to call his own.
Quest.q_halloweenneighborhood_task2_hint: Fill first block by placing 5 houses in it
Quest.q_halloweenneighborhood_dialog_finish: Now that the monsters have moved in, I'd like to give them all a welcome casket. It's the least I can do.
Quest.q_holiday_town_1_dialog_header: Let's shake off the Giving Tree's winter frost and decorate the tree with ornaments and candy canes!
Quest.q_holiday_town_1_task1_hint: I bet there's some at the landmarks
Quest.q_holiday_town_1_task3_hint: Harvest Businesses for a chance of collecting Holiday Lights!
Quest.q_holiday_town_1_dialog_finish: The Giving Tree looks beautiful! Complete 3 more goals to have it fully decorated in your city!
Quest.q_holiday_town_2_intro: I know what would make the perfect tree topper! A bright, shining star! Let's go find one!
Quest.q_holiday_town_2_dialog_header: I knew I should've brought one with me just in case!  At least we can find one pretty easily this time of year.
Quest.q_holiday_town_2_task1: Collect 3 Holiday Stars from Winter Buildings or Ask Friends
Quest.q_holiday_town_2_task1_hint: Ask friends or collect from winter buildings. Both work!
Quest.q_holiday_town_2_task3_hint: We need more elves to help us find the perfect tree topper
Quest.q_holiday_town_2_dialog_finish: We're so close to turning on the lights of the Giving Tree!  2 goals to go!
Quest.q_holiday_town_3_dialog_header: Let's see where the Holiday Grouch hid the Giving Tree! We need to form a search party immediately!
Quest.q_holiday_town_4_dialog_header: Now, all we need are some carolers to gather around the Giving Tree to bring it to life!
Quest.q_holiday_town_4_task1_hint: Harvest Residences for a chance to hear Holiday Songs!
Quest.q_holiday_town_4_task2_hint: The carolers will probably be hungry!
Quest.q_holiday_town_4_task3: Send 20 tour buses to your friends
Quest.q_holiday_town_4_dialog_finish: Congratulations!  You've completed all goals and get the Giving Tree.  Click on the tree to unlock it.
Quest.q_minigolf_intro: Alright, Stumpfords! It's time for some friendly family competition! Let's hit the greens and play some mini golf!
Quest.q_minigolf_dialog_header: Let's make this interesting, kids. Whoever wins the round of mini golf gets to pick where we go to lunch!
Quest.q_minigolf_task2: Collect from the French Restaurant 16 times
Quest.q_minigolf_dialog_hint: This is quest part 1 of 4.  Complete them all for the Big Play Brewery!
Quest.q_minigolf2_task2: Collect from the Noodle Shop 16 times
Quest.q_minigolf2_task3_hint: The noodles are made of the finest flour
Quest.q_minigolf2_task1_hint: Get us a locker while I get our tickets
Quest.q_minigolf2_dialog_hint: This is quest part 2 of 4.  Complete them all for the Big Play Brewery!
Quest.q_minigolf3_intro: Now, remember that I take mini golf very seriously. So, don't be surprised if I get teed off if I lose.
Quest.q_minigolf3_dialog_header: But if I don't win, I'm putting my money on Ross. Just remember who pays your allowance, son.
Quest.q_minigolf3_dialog_hint: This is quest part 3 of 4.  Complete them all for the Big Play Brewery!
Quest.q_minigolf4_dialog_header: Wow, what a game! I still can't believe I won! Usually, your mother beats me at everything!
Quest.q_minigolf4_task3_hint: The main ingredient of the amazing carrot cake
Quest.q_minigolf4_dialog_finish: Well, Stumpfords, it's time to hang up our mini golf cleats! I'm lucky to have such an amazing family!
Quest.q_minigolf4_dialog_hint: This is quest part 4 of 4.  Complete them all for the Big Play Brewery!
Quest.q_monsterdentist_intro: Too much Halloween candy is giving the monsters tooth aches! We need a Demented Dentist immediately!
Quest.q_monsterdentist_task1_hint: I hope I need a root canal
Quest.q_monsterdentist_task3_hint: The Demented Dentist has to live somewhere
Quest.q_monsterdentist_dialog_finish: We finished just in time! Now my teeth are ready to bite whatever and whomever I want!
Quest.q_petshow2_intro: I'm going to enter my pigeons into a pet show! These pigeons are always poised in pageants. Try saying that fast!
Quest.q_petshow2_task2: Collect 12 times from any Zoo enclosure
Quest.q_petshow2_task2_hint: If you only have one enclosure, build another!
Quest.q_petshow2_task3_hint: Only the finest imports will do
Quest.q_shipping_upgrades_1_intro: I've been promoted to Harbor Master! Now that I'm in charge, you either shape up or ship out!
Quest.q_shipping_upgrades_1_dialog_finish: I know more about business than I lead on! I'm gonna steer this harbor toward a profit, just you wait!
Quest.q_shipping_upgrades_1_dialog_header: This dock area needs a spit shine. Let's start with the pier! Grab a mop and start swabbin'!
Quest.q_shipping_upgrades_2_dialog_finish: This is the life! I'd much rather be down here in the salt air instead of cooped up in some drafty castle!
Quest.q_shipping_upgrades_3_task1: Collect from Natural History Museum 2 times
Quest.q_shipping_upgrades_4_intro: Wanna know the next big thing in the shipping industry?! I've got two words for ya. Super Freighter!
Quest.q_shipping_upgrades_4_dialog_finish: We're headin' in the right direction. But we're gonna need all hands on deck to finish this thing!
Quest.q_shipping_upgrades_4_dialog_header: I underestimated the size of this Super Freighter! We're gonna need a bigger pier!
Quest.q_shipping_upgrades_5_dialog_finish: We did it! This is the life, I tell ya! I think I could get used being a Harbor Master!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act1_1_intro: Since I'm stranded so far away from the North Pole, I'm going to need a workshop where I can make everyone's gifts!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act1_1_task2_hint: Place Santa's Workshop to Start Collecting Gifts
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act1_1_dialog_finish: Thanks for giving me a hand! This workshop is just as nice as the one I have back home!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act1_2_dialog_header: All we need are a few trees, a couple of wreaths, and a lot of tinsel! You can never have enough tinsel!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act1_2_task2: Collect 10 times from the Holiday Bakery Business
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act1_2_task2_hint: There's nothing like holiday spiced cookies!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act1_2_epilogue_message: The city looks festive and full of holiday cheer! I can't wait until the big day arrives!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act1_3_intro: They say it's better to give than to receive. But let's face it. Receiving is not so bad, either!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act1_3_dialog_header: Let's fill all the stockings to the very top! I wonder how many presents we can fit in each one!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act1_3_dialog_finish: Wow, with all these amazing presents, this is going to be the best holiday season ever!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act1_3_epilogue_message: You were a huge help with finding gifts! Maybe you should have my job!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act2_1_task2: Complete the first Holiday Town Gate
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act2_1_task3_hint: Collecting from Residences gives a chance at collecting Holiday Cheer!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act2_1_dialog_finish: Thanks for the help! You'd make a great elf. But you probably wouldn't look very good in our shoes.
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act2_1_epilogue_message: We elves are glad we found Santa! Just let us know how we can return the favor sometime!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act2_2_task2: Collect 5 times from Flying Reindeer Stable
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act2_2_dialog_finish: The reindeer are ready to take to the sky! We better buckle up or we're gonna have to use our parachutes!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act2_2_epilogue_message: Wow, the reindeer really like you! Here, take the reins and let's see what you can do!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act2_3_intro: Everything's falling into place over at Santa's workshop! Let's get your city ready for the best holiday in history!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act2_3_task2_hint: Friends are in town for the holidays
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act2_3_task3: Harvest 10 Ships to the North Pole
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act2_3_task3_hint: All the elves need to be in one place
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act2_3_dialog_finish: This city really knows how to party! Even the pigeons are getting in on the holiday festivities!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act2_3_epilogue_message: Usually, it's us that makes the holidays special! But you're the one who's making this year special!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act3_1_task2_hint: Toys are in high demand as usual
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act3_1_task3_hint: Holiday Town is waiting for us
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act3_1_dialog_finish: Now, that's more like it! All this city needed was a little dose of Mrs. Claus's medicine!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act3_2_intro: The holidays are a time to celebrate with loved ones! And what better way to celebrate than with a party!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act3_2_dialog_header: I know how to throw amazing holiday parties! We just need some good music and room to dance!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act3_2_task1: Collect 12 Jingle Bells by Harvesting Community Buildings
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act3_2_task1_hint: Harvest from Community Buildings for a chance to collect Jingle Bells
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act3_2_task2: Collect 20 Elf Shoes by Harvesting Residences
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act3_2_task2_hint: Harvest from Residences for a chance to collect Elf Shoes
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act3_2_task3: Complete the 3rd and 4th Holiday Town Gates
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act3_2_task3_hint: The final pieces of the Holiday puzzle
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act3_2_epilogue_message: The holiday party was a huge success! Even the reindeer got in on the action!
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act3_3_task3_hint: Harvest from Crops for a chance to collect Holidy Spice
Quest.q_xmas_saga_act3_3_epilogue_message: On behalf of Santa and myself, this is one holiday season that we'll never forget!
Quest.qf_animalrescue_dialog_header: I think your city needs a Doggie Rescue Center to help pets find their way home!
Quest.qf_birthday_2011_dialog_start: It's almost time to celebrate CityVille's birthday! What are you going to wish for?!
Quest.qf_candybooth_intro: This city needs a Treats 'n Sweets candy booth to satisfy my sweet tooth! Or should I say, sweet fang?!
Quest.qf_candybooth_dialog_header: Hurry! Let's rush to get this Treats 'n Sweets candy booth up and running before the sun comes up!
Quest.qf_cars_task2_hint: After completing the Garage supply businesses to see cars in your city
Quest.qf_cars_task3_hint: Click on cars to collect coins
Quest.qf_cars2_task2_hint: Click on cars for a chance at a car jack
Quest.qf_cars2_task3: Collect 15 times from a Gas Station
Quest.qf_cars2_task3_hint: Buildings on a road increase car payouts, find the Gas Station in the Build Menu
Quest.qf_cars2_dialog_finish: I'm rusty but I'm not terrible! Hey, let's see how well you drive after a year with no cars!
Quest.qf_cars3_dialog_header: If we're going to have cars driving around here, we're going to need more roads. Let's pound the pavement!
Quest.qf_cars3_dialog_finish: This whole car thing is going to be big! But I'll let my cab driver do the driving for now!
Quest.qf_carcraft_intro: I used to race cars for a livin'. Now that I'm retired, I prefer to collect 'em and fix 'em!
Quest.qf_carcraft_dialog_header: I think runnin' a Custom Car Shop would be a lot of fun! Complete the Car Shop to build cars for your city!
Quest.qf_carcraft_task1_hint: Complete the Custom Car Shop to build cars for your city!
Quest.qf_carcraft_task2_hint: After completing the Custom Car Shop, click on Cars for a chance at Car Parts
Quest.qf_carcraft_task3_hint: Build a Car at the Custom Car Shop
Quest.qf_carcraft_dialog_finish: Wow, I can't believe how much time I'm spendin' in this Custom Car Shop! Time flies when you're havin' fun!
Quest.qf_carcraft2_task2_hint: Place your Car Wash reward from the Car Collector goal
Quest.qf_carcraft2_task3_hint: Build Cars at the Custom Car Shop
Quest.qf_carcraft2_dialog_finish: After waxin' these cars, they look like they should be in a museum! Nice work, everybody!
Quest.qf_carcraft3_intro: Now that all the cars are cleaned up, I say we take 'em for a test drive! If you got 'em, flaunt 'em!
Quest.qf_carcraft3_dialog_header: I better clean out the trunk of my car just in case the test drivers look in there!
Quest.qf_carcraft3_task2_hint: Keep your businesses supplied to see cars on your streets
Quest.qf_carcraft3_dialog_finish: These cars sure are fast! Even more cars are coming soon!
Quest.qf_coreloop_winter2011_intro: The holidays mean one thing to me. It's time to put on another dazzling production of "The Nutcracker"!
Quest.qf_coreloop_winter2011_dialog_header: Before my ballet company can take the stage, we need to have a stage in the first place! Let's get to work!
Quest.qf_gardens_dialog_header: I'm gettin' so excited about the rose garden! Just think about how beautiful it'll be when we're done!
Quest.qf_gardens_dialog_hint: This is quest part 1 of 4.  Complete all for great garden prizes!
Quest.qf_gardens_task2_hint: Click the Plant button in the Rose Garden Menu to plant a rose.
Quest.qf_gardens_dialog_finish: Don't get me wrong, I really enjoy plantin' all my crops on the farm. But these roses are just more fun!
Quest.qf_gardens_2_intro: It's taken me this long to have a rose garden and, by golly, I'm gonna make the most of it!
Quest.qf_gardens_2_dialog_header: They say that variety is the spice of life. So, let's plant even more gardens!
Quest.qf_gardens_2_dialog_hint: This is quest part 2 of 4.  Complete all for great garden prizes!
Quest.qf_gardens_2_task2_hint: You can buy Gardens by clicking on the "Get Gardens" button in the Rose Garden Menu
Quest.qf_gardens_2_task3_hint: You can water your Gardens every 18 hours
Quest.qf_gardens_2_dialog_finish: The gardens look great! And I think these roses are purdy enough to win a rose show! Whaddya say?!
Quest.qf_gardens_3_intro: If we're gonna win this here rose show, we're gonna have to get these roses ready! It's time to empower these flowers!
Quest.qf_gardens_3_dialog_header: Those other roses don't stand a chance against ours! We're gonna make 'em wilt!
Quest.qf_gardens_3_dialog_hint: This is quest part 3 of 4.  Complete all for great garden prizes!
Quest.qf_gardens_3_task1_hint: Get Roses for your garden from the Market under the Decorations tab
Quest.qf_gardens_3_task3_hint: You can find the Rose Gate in Decorations in the Build Menu.
Quest.qf_gardens_4_intro: Oh, my gosh! We won the rose show! We rose to the challenge and rose above the competition! Get it?! Roses?!
Quest.qf_gardens_4_dialog_hint: This is quest part 4 of 4. Complete all for great garden prizes!
Quest.qf_gardens_4_task2_hint: Click the "Plant" button in the Rose Garden Menu to plant a Rose
Quest.qf_gardens_4_dialog_finish: Looks like some of the other contestants are jealous that we won! I don't blame 'em. We kicked their buds!
Quest.qf_halloween_1_dialog_header: Have no fear. We monsters are more afraid of you than you are of us! But I am a little thirsty!
Quest.qf_halloween_1_task1_hint: Make your monsters feel more at home with a Halloween Theme from the Marketplace
Quest.qf_halloween_1_dialog_finish: Thank you for helping us get our lives back to normal! And I'm not just sucking up to you.
Quest.qux_deco_ghost_ship_hint: Complete the Creatures of Habit Goal to unlock the Ghost Ship!
Quest.qf_halloween_1_2_dialog_header: If you need me, I'll be six feet under. Oh, I hope I have an awful nightmare!
Quest.qf_halloween_1_2_dialog_finish: Oh, could you wake me when the sun goes down? I'm not really a morning person.
Quest.qux_deco_tombgrave_hint: Complete the Waking the Dead Goal to unlock the Abandoned Tomb!
Quest.qf_halloween_1_3_intro: Thanks for showing us monsters so much hospitality. Maybe one of these days I can have you for dinner.
Quest.qf_halloween_1_3_dialog_header: I have a pretty big family. You know what they say? A blood sucker's born every minute.
Quest.qf_halloween_1_3_task1_hint: The more jack o'lanterns, the better
Quest.qf_halloween_1_3_dialog_finish: I'm making you an honorary member of my family! Thanks for sticking your neck out for me!
Quest.qux_mun_witch_flight_school_hint: Complete the Blood Relatives Goal to unlock the Witchwart Academy!
Quest.qf_halloween_2_dialog_header: I'm not afraid to bite off more than I can chew. Do you know any place that need a night manager?
Quest.qf_halloween_2_task1: Place an item won from the Halloween Mystery Crate Game
Quest.qf_halloween_2_task1_hint: It's all fun and games until someone loses an eye
Quest.qf_halloween_2_task2: Master Pumpkins or Jack O'Lanterns to Level 1
Quest.qf_halloween_2_dialog_finish: We just have to be positive about getting jobs. Get it? Be positive? Blood? Never mind.
Quest.qux_deco_spooky_tree_hint: Complete the In Goods Spirits Goal to unlock the Treacherous Tree!
Quest.qf_halloween_2_2_dialog_finish: I hope you slept better than me. I tossed and turned in my coffin all night!
Quest.qux_res_countryhome_halloween_hint: Complete the Grim Sleeper Goal to unlock the Creepy Country Cottage!
Quest.qf_halloween_2_3_task1_hint: I bet you can find some that look like me
Quest.qf_halloween_2_3_task2: Master Pumpkins or Jack O'Lanterns to Level 3
Quest.qux_bus_werewolf_lodge_hint: Complete the At Death's Door Goal to unlock the Warewolf Lodge!
Quest.qf_halloween_3_task1_hint: I can trade in my candy for ghoulish prizes
Quest.qf_halloween_3_task2: Place a prize purchased with Candy
Quest.qf_halloween_3_dialog_finish: You're turning out to be quite the advantage! you know where all the best candy spots are!
Quest.qux_bus_witch_hat_shop_hint: Complete the Sweet Spot Goal to unlock the Witches Hat Shop!
Quest.qf_halloween_3_2_dialog_header: I've been browsing all over for cob webs. Know where we can find some really scary ones?!
Quest.qf_halloween_3_2_dialog_finish: Thanks for letting more of my friends move in! I haven't seen them in centuries!
Quest.qux_res_swamphouse02_hint: Complete the Frightening Friends Goal to unlock the Treacherous Trailer!
Quest.qf_halloween_3_3_intro: We monsters are professional trick or treaters. Stand back and let us show you how it's done!
Quest.qf_halloween_3_3_dialog_header: I can hit more houses than the other monsters because I fly instead of walking! Prepare for takeoff!
Quest.qf_halloween_3_3_dialog_finish: I have to admit, your costume is pretty good! You even scared me and that's saying something!
Quest.qux_wizard_house_hint: Complete the Dressed to Kill Goal to unlock the Warlock House!
Quest.qf_malls_task2: Place 2 Restaurants into a Food Court
Quest.qf_malls_task2_hint: Click on the Food Court to bring up the Mall Menu
Quest.qf_mb_2_intro: I can sing acappella but I prefer to have my band behind me. The more the merrier, I say!
Quest.qf_mb_2_dialog_header: I know it's cold out here, but I hope my band doesn't flake on me! The concert's about to start!
Quest.qf_mb_2_task2_hint: I love cranberry sauce for the holidays
Quest.qf_mb_2_dialog_finish: I don't want to sound like a broken record, but I love this city! I can't wait to come back here to perform!
Quest.qf_minicoreloop_gov_task1_hint: Click the Mansion to pull up the Task Menu
Quest.qf_mj_1_intro: Let's celebrate Michael Jackson's music and bring the Immortal Tour to your city!
Quest.qf_mj_1_dialog_header: The King of Pop is going to need an arena fit for a king! This show is going to be a thriller!
Quest.qf_mj_1_dialog_hint: Ask for gloves to collect for MJ's Immortal Arena faster!
Quest.qf_mj_1_task1: Place and Complete MJ's Immortal Arena
Quest.qf_mj_1_task1_hint: Show Arena has a Place Button
Quest.qf_mj_1_task3: Collect all 5 parts of the MJ Collection
Quest.qf_mj_1_task3_hint: Collection items should drop when collecting from the Show Arena
Quest.qf_mj_1_dialog_finish: All the shows were sold out but I snuck in and saw the whole thing! Wow, what an amazing show!
Quest.qf_mj_2_task2_hint: Harvest from businesses or residences for a chance to start a flash mob!
Quest.qf_neighborhoods_intro: Looks like you need to pack a lot of homes into a small space! So, let’s build some neighborhoods!
Quest.qf_neighborhoods_task1_hint: You can find it in the Build Menu under Housing in the Neighborhood tab
Quest.qf_neighborhoods_dialog_finish: Your neighborhood looks great so far! If you don’t mind, I’m going to stick around and keep helping out!
Quest.qf_neighborhoods_2_intro: Now that you’ve got some new neighbors, let’s throw a block party so they can all mingle!
Quest.qf_neighborhoods_2_dialog_header: We need to get the word out that this is going to be a huge celebration. Architects know how to throw down!
Quest.qf_neighborhoods_2_task2: Place 1 more Residence into your Neighborhood
Quest.qf_neighborhoods_2_task3_hint: HINT: Garden Gnome decoration can be found in your inventory
Quest.qf_neighborhoods_3_dialog_header: People are coming from all over to live in your new neighborhood! Well, let’s help them settle in!
Quest.qf_neighborhoods_3_task1_hint: Click up on the Neighborhood to bring up the Neighborhood Menu
Quest.qf_neighborhoods_3_dialog_finish: Everyone seems to be getting along so far! Let’s put out the welcome mat and show them some hospitality!
Quest.qf_neighborhoods_4_intro: Let’s go show your new neighbors our appreciation and bring them some house warming gifts!
Quest.qf_neighborhoods_4_dialog_header: One thing that everyone loves is baked goods! I make a mean butter cookie, by the way!
Quest.qf_universities_dialog_finish: You're a quick study! The University looks great and is ready to accept students immediately!
Quest.qf_universities_2_dialog_header: Earning my degree was very challenging but very rewarding. Good luck getting started!
Quest.qf_universities_2_dialog_finish: I've forgotten how exhausting college is! If you need me, I'll be taking a nap on your futon!
Quest.qf_universities_3_dialog_header: All this studying has made me hungry! I think I'm going to get a quick snack. See you around campus!
Quest.qf_universities_3_task3_hint: Don't want your parents to get lost
Quest.qf_universities_3_dialog_finish: Your University looks great! You definitely get an "A" for effort. Let me know if you need me to teach a class!
Quest.qf_windfarm_1_task3_hint: Let's make sure it's okay for us to have a picnic
Quest.qf_windfarm_1_dialog_finish: Boy, that was fun to spend time with my son! But I don't remember it bein' so windy up there!
Quest.qf_windfarm_2_intro: I think those hills would be a great place for a Wind Farm! You can never have enough renewable energy!
Quest.qf_windfarm_2_dialog_header: I'm gonna take this petition door to door and then I'm gonna show City Hall we mean business!
Quest.qf_windfarm_2_dialog_finish: All those signatures are proof that a Wind Farm is what this city needs right now!
Quest.qf_windfarm_3_intro: I agree that a Wind Farm would benefit our city but I just want to make sure it wouldn't harm the environment.
Quest.qf_windfarm_3_dialog_header: A lot of birds live in those hills. Let's make sure their homes won't be affected by the Wind Farm.
Quest.qf_windfarm_3_task3_hint: Some of the birds could safely live here
Quest.qf_windfarm_4_intro: The Wind Farm has been approved! These hills are gonna get new life and help power the city!
Quest.qf_windfarm_4_dialog_header: I betcha this Wind Farm is gonna be a huge success! I'm glad everyone got behind the idea!
Quest.qf_windfarm_4_dialog_finish: Even though this Wind Farm's up here, I'm still gonna lay down my blanket and have my picnics!
Quest.qm_applefarm_intro: It just wouldn't be the holidays without hot apple pie! But y'all are gonna need a Apple Orchard first!
Quest.qm_back_to_school_task2_hint: Used school supplies still get the job done
Quest.qm_back_to_school_task3_hint: Mom's going to bake some bread for sandwiches
Quest.qm_back_to_school_dialog_hint: This is quest part 1 of 4. Complete them all for a Football Field!
Quest.qm_back_to_school_dialog_finish: Honey, I'm stuffed! Let's say we go burn off these calories the old fashioned way. By reading!
Quest.qm_back_to_school2_dialog_header: You have to have street smarts as well as book smarts, kids. But I only know how to get book smarts.
Quest.qm_back_to_school2_dialog_hint: This is quest part 2 of 4. Complete them all for a Football Field!
Quest.qm_back_to_school2_dialog_finish: Treat your teachers with the same respect you treat your parents, kids. On second thought, double it.
Quest.qm_back_to_school3_task1_hint: You kids deserve a nice place to study
Quest.qm_back_to_school3_task3_hint: Safety first! You can find a Crossing Guard in the Decorations Menu
Quest.qm_back_to_school3_dialog_hint: This is quest part 3 of 4.  Complete them all for a Football Field!
Quest.qm_back_to_school3_dialog_finish: As much as your mother and I would love to tell you about our school days, I think the first bell just rang! Bye!
Quest.qm_back_to_school4_intro: Well, honey, now that the kids are back in school how bout we celebrate our freedom out on the town?!
Quest.qm_back_to_school4_task1: Have 2 pairs of High Heels from the Designer Collection
Quest.qm_back_to_school4_task1_hint: Collect from Shoe Store, Handbag Store, Sunglasses Store, or Watch Shop
Quest.qm_back_to_school4_dialog_hint: This is quest part 4 of 4. Complete them all for a Football Field!
Quest.qm_back_to_school4_dialog_finish: Well, Stumpfords, we made it to another school year without incident. Wait, where's my pocket protector?!
Quest.qm_citysymphony_dialog_header: I can't believe your city doesn't have a Symphony Hall! Well, we're going to do something about that.
Quest.qm_citysymphony_task1_hint: Increases population allowed by 11,250, music to my ears
Quest.qm_clown_intro: In my opinion, everyone deserves an education. And that includes clowns. So, a new Clown College is opening up soon!
Quest.qm_clown_dialog_header: I remember my college days fondly. I just wish I’d learned how to not take everything so seriously.
Quest.qm_clown_dialog_hint: This is quest part 1 of 4.  Complete all for great circus prizes!
Quest.qm_clown_2_intro: It’s inspiring to be around all these aspiring clowns. They’re all so passionate about being funny.
Quest.qm_clown_2_dialog_header: If I’m going to make it to the big top of my class, I’m going to need to dress for success.
Quest.qm_clown_2_dialog_hint: This is quest part 2 of 4.  Complete all for great circus prizes!
Quest.qm_clown_2_task2: Send and collect from 10 Boats to Paris for Clown Shoes
Quest.qm_clown_2_dialog_finish: I look pretty funny! You know what they say? Dress for the job you want, not the job you have.
Quest.qm_clown_3_intro: That does it. If I’m going to be the best clown I can be, I’m going to have to spend more time with my nose in books and pies.
Quest.qm_clown_3_dialog_header: Being funny is serious business. And that’s why I’m going to make this Clown College my main priority!
Quest.qm_clown_3_dialog_hint: This is quest part 3 of 4.  Complete all for great circus prizes!
Quest.qm_clown_3_task1: Upgrade and Harvest the Clown College
Quest.qm_clown_3_task2_hint: Pie Faced Pete is making a mockery of serious clowning
Quest.qm_clown_4_dialog_hint: This is quest part 4 of 4. Complete all for great circus prizes!
Quest.qm_clown_4_task3_hint: These can be collected from the Bowling Alley, Pool Hall, and Tavern
Quest.qm_clown_4_dialog_finish: Wow, what a rush! After hearing an entire audience laugh, I think may have found my new calling!
Quest.qm_clown_4_epilogue_message: I’m leaving politics behind and joining the circus. Good luck filling my very, very big shoes.
Quest.qm_coliseum_intro: We're so lucky that a marvel such as the Coliseum is still intact! Let's make sure every citizen gets a chance to see it!
Quest.qm_farmers_intro: Enroll at the University of Farmers and complete the collection to get the Farmers Insurance Autoboathome decoration.
Quest.qm_farmers_task1: Place University of Farmers Community Building
Quest.qm_farmers_task1_hint: Redeem the completed collection by November 3rd to get the Farmers Insurance Autoboathome decoration.
Quest.qm_farmers_dialog_finish: Complete the University of Farmers collection by November 3rd and get the Autoboathome limited edition decoration.
Quest.qm_farmers_dialog_header: One of the best payouts ever. Earn 3 energy, coins, and XP.
Quest.qm_promo_bbuy_intro: Place Best Buy® business to get more.
Quest.qm_promo_bbuy_dialog_hint: Big payouts and energy each time you collect from you business.
Quest.qm_promo_bbuy_dialog_finish: Check your Inventory for the Best Buy More Surprises Decoration.
Quest.qm_promo_bbuy2_intro: Place your Best Buy® business to get more. Limited time only.
Quest.qm_promo_2bbuy_dialog_header: Place Best Buy® business to get more. Limited time only.
Quest.qm_promo_2bbuy_dialog_finish: Check your Inventory for the Holiday Surprises Sleigh decoration.
Quest.qm_spyagency_dialog_header: I'd be happy to spy for you, if you want. And since I like you so much, the first job's on the house!
Quest.qm_spyagency_dialog_finish: You know, I used to date a spy. I wonder what happened to him. I should spy on him!
Quest.qm_stadiums_baseball_intro: Your city would sparkle a whole lot more if it had a diamond in it. A baseball diamond, that is!
Quest.qm_stadiums_baseball_task2_hint: Slide into home. Increase population allowed by 3,000
Quest.qm_stadiums_baseball_dialog_finish: Your new baseball stadium looks fantastic! Let me know if you want me to throw out the first pitch!
Quest.qm_stadiums_soccer_intro: Wanna know how your city can have a leg up on the competition?! Build a soccer stadium!
Quest.qm_stadiums_soccer_dialog_header: Not only will a soccer stadium bring in revenue to your city, it’ll raise the population as well!
Quest.qm_stadiums_soccer_task2_hint: Your citizens can't wait. Increase population allowed by 5,000
Quest.qm_swissmuseum_intro: There's so much to love about Switzerland! Let's put a museum in your city to celebrate the Swiss!
Quest.qm_swissmuseum_dialog_header: Be sure to get your photo taken next to the Swiss cheese display! But try not to eat it!
Quest.qm_swissmuseum_task2_hint: Increase your population allowed by 1000 all with Swiss tools
Quest.qm_swissmuseum_dialog_finish: This museum has a little bit of everything! It's like a Swiss army knife! It even has one of those, too!
Quest.qm_vacation_dialog_header: Trust me, kids. Living in a neighborhood with other families will be great. Have I ever been wrong before?!
Quest.qt_artauction_task2_hint: Local businesses are chipping in with charity donations
Quest.qt_artshow_intro: My art students have really outdone themselves! I say we put on an Art Show to display their work!
Quest.qt_artshow_dialog_header: I could never draw as well as they can! I bet we'll have people lining up to buy their art!
Quest.qt_artshow_dialog_finish: Wow! We sold every item! I'd much rather be called a sell out than a starving artist!
Quest.qt_barnraising_task3_hint: We can't build a barn without 'em
Quest.qt_cidermill_intro: It just wouldn't be the holidays without hot apple cider! But y'all are gonna need a Cider Mill first!
Quest.qt_cidermill_dialog_header: The key to makin' good cider is havin' the best apples! The bigger, the better!
Quest.qt_exotic_pet_show_dialog_header: My favorite part of the show is seeing all the puppies prance out for the judges! They're so cute!
Quest.qt_exotic_pet_show_task1: Collect from the Sailboat Hotel 2 times
Quest.qt_exotic_pet_show_task1_hint: Unloading a cruise ship delivers tourists that like to check into hotels
Quest.qt_exotic_pet_show_task2: Upgrade 12 friends to VIP status in your hotel
Quest.qt_exotic_pet_show_task2_hint: VIP friends checked into your Sailboat Hotel will help fill it faster
Quest.qt_exotic_pet_show_dialog_finish: These animals are so adorable that I can't take it anymore! Stop the show!
Quest.qt_expansion_quest_intro: My birthday wish is coming true! The local cops are going to take me out in a helicopter!
Quest.qt_expansion_quest_dialog_header: When I was a little girl, I dreamed about being a news anchor doing a live report from high above the city!
Quest.qt_expansion_quest_task3_hint: I've got to report my story directly. Find it in the Build menu under the Municipals tab
Quest.qt_expansion_quest_dialog_finish: No matter how old you are, you can always follow your dreams! For CityVille News, I've been Sam. Back to you.
Quest.qt_expansion_quest_lighthouse_intro: Earn the Lighthouse to make your city a safe harbor so Rusty and his crew can make safe voyages!
Quest.qt_expansion_quest_lighthouse_dialog_fin: Seeing a landlubber have so much dedication to seafarers has made this ol’ sea dog proud!
Quest.qt_harvest_fest_dialog_header: The fall is by far my favorite time of year! This is going to be the best harvest festival we've ever had!
Quest.qt_harvest_fest_dialog_finish: The harvest festival looks good enough to eat! It's going to be hard to top this next year!
Quest.qt_iceskating_dialog_header: Oh, I wish I could find my lucky hockey stick! I guess I'll just use my axe handle!
Quest.qt_iceskating_task2_hint: We need to raise money for equipment
Quest.qt_iceskating_dialog_finish: I really have to tip my hat to these kids! They skated circles around me, that's fer sure!
Quest.qt_iceskating_dialog_start: Embrace winter and make it your goal to ice skate in CityVille today! Finish faster for better rewards!
Quest.qt_outdoorfishing_intro: You just gotta love a sport that you get to do in the great outdoors. Let's show these bass who's boss!
Quest.qt_outdoorfishing_dialog_header: Before we have ourselves a little catch and release tournament, we should stock up on supplies and snacks!
Quest.qt_outdoorfishing_task3_hint: If you don't have a Seafood Restaurant, now is a good time to get one.
Quest.qt_outdoorfishing_dialog_finish: Wow! Those bass were practically jumpin' into the boat!  But I'm glad to be back on land where I belong!
Quest.qt_perfect_tree_task2_hint: Collect from businesses for a chance at a Wreath Clipping
Quest.qt_perfect_tree_dialog_finish: Look at that beautiful tree! Now, that's what the holidays are all about! I promised myself I wouldn't cry!
Quest.qt_snowballfight_intro: The family that plays together stays together! Let's have a snowball fight!
Quest.qt_snowballfight_dialog_header: Our snow fort is impenetrable! Go ahead, take your best shot at the Stumpfords! We dare you!
Quest.qt_snowballfight_task2_hint: They can be rewarded from rent collections in your City
Quest.qt_snowballfight_dialog_finish: Even though we're enemies in the snowball fight doesn't mean we can't be friends! Let's call a truce!
Quest.qt_superdeco_task2_hint: People will come from miles around
Quest.qt_superdeco_dialog_finish: The super solar panel is a worldwide phenomenon! It's completely reenergized my career!
Quest.qf_wonder_craft_intro: It's time you make a statement in your city of epic proportions! Let's add the Wonders of the World to your skyline!
Quest.qf_wonder_craft_task3_hint: Collect from Wonder themed buildings to earn parts!
Quest.qf_wonder_craft_dialog_finish: Now that you have your Wonder Lumber, I've got a feeling that building Wonders is going to be easy for you!
Quest.qf_wonder_craft2_intro: Your Wonders of the World are looking good so far! It's only a matter of time before they're up and running in your city!
Quest.qf_wonder_craft2_dialog_header: Let's completely upgrade your Wonder so you can impress your citizens sooner than later!
Quest.qf_wonder_craft2_task1_hint: Complete a Wonder by upgrading it to Level 6!
Quest.qf_wonder_craft3_dialog_header: Remember, they're called Wonders for a reason! Let's get back to work so we can amaze your citizens!
Quest.qf_wonder_craft3_dialog_finish: Congratulations on completing all 7 of your Wonders of the World! You really did a wonderful job with them!
Quest.qt_nanotechschool_task1_hint: To finish your Nanotechnology School, click it to bring up the Build Menu
Quest.qt_nanotechschool_dialog_finish: Now that you have a Nanotechnology School in your city, it looks like the nerds will have the last laugh!
Quest.qt_sciencecenter_intro: Take on the challenge of completing the Science Center to get amazing payouts and start unlocking the Tesla Coil!
Quest.qt_sciencecenter_task1_hint: To finish your Science Center, click it to bring up the Build Menu
Quest.qt_sciencecenter_dialog_finish: Now that you have your Science Center, you’re closer to having your Tesla Coil! Let’s go out with a bang!
Quest.qt_satellitedish_intro: Take on the challenge of finishing the Satellite Dish to get amazing payouts and start unlocking the Tesla Coil Wonder!
Quest.qt_satellitedish_task1_hint: To finish your Satellite Dish, click it to bring up the Build Menu
Quest.qt_satellitedish_dialog_finish: Congrats! Now that you have your Satellite Dish, you’re one step closer to having your Tesla Coil Wonder!
Quest.qf_equality_district_dialog_header: We can communicate better in your Equality District if we use walkie talkies! Let’s see if your friends have some!
Quest.qf_equality_district_task1_hint: Equality District takes ALL businesses, community buildings and residences
Quest.qf_equality_district_task3: Upgrade your Equality District Neighborhood to Block 2
Quest.qf_equality_district_task3_hint: Imagine how much space you can save
Quest.qf_equality_district2_intro: Your Equality District is filling up with residents! You should put together a phonebook so they can keep in touch!
Quest.qf_equality_district2_dialog_header: I’m glad I’ve gotten in on the ground floor with your Equality District Mall! Let’s upgrade it to Floor 2!
Quest.qf_equality_district2_task2: Upgrade your Equality District Mall to Floor 2
Quest.qf_equality_district2_task3_hint: You can launch missions from the space shuttle Launch Pad
Quest.qf_equality_district2_dialog_finish: Your Equality District is already out of this world! So let's blast off on a mission to Mars! Come on! Let's go!
Quest.qf_equality_district3_intro: I’ve been knocking on your door for the past ten minutes trying to tell you how much I love your Equality District!
Quest.qf_equality_district3_dialog_header: Maybe you should get some new Door Knockers. At least then you’ll be able to hear me next time!
Quest.qf_equality_district3_task2: Upgrade your Equality District Civic Center to  Floor 3
Quest.qf_equality_district3_dialog_finish: You really laid down the law with your new Equality District. Maybe you should be the district attorney!
Quest.qf_watercrops_intro: You seem to be the cream of the crop with those landlubbers but let’s see if you can rule the sea with crops as well!
Quest.qf_watercrops_task1: Place & Complete the Fish Hatchery on water
Quest.qf_watercrops2_dialog_header: The chefs at the Cooking School are cookin' up ways to use those Water Crops in their recipes!
Quest.qf_watercrops2_dialog_finish: I wanna level with you. I'm really impressed with your Level 3 City Port. Just thought you should know.
Quest.qf_watercrops3_intro: If you really want to fish for compliments for your Fish Hatchery, you’re going to need to upgrade it to Level 3!
Quest.qf_watercrops3_dialog_finish: You did great with those water crops! Even though you’re a landlubber, you really are the cream of the crop!
Quest.q_internationalchapter_task2_hint: Upgrade your Train Station to a level 3 High Speed Railway!
Quest.q_internationalchapter_dialog_reward_Dec: Completing these goals will earn you the United Nations Center, the symbol of your city's international diversity!
Quest.q_internationalchapter_2_dialog_reward_D: Completing these goals will earn you the Mayoral Fundraiser Mansion, the symbol of your victorious Mayoral election!
Quest.q_internationalchapter_3_task4_hint: Complete all 9 goals of the Run for Governor Goals.
Quest.q_internationalchapter_3_dialog_reward_D: Completing these goals will earn you the State Senate Building, the symbol of your victorious Gubernatorial election!
Quest.q_agnostic_hood_task1_hint: You can start collecting before your place
Quest.q_airport_upgrade_1_task1_hint: Hint: Gives all planes faster travel times!
Quest.q_airport_upgrade_1_task3_hint: Get ready for some rad rewards
Quest.q_airport_upgrade_2_dialog_header: After we increase your city’s population, we’ll have a full flight on our hands! So squeeze in back there!
Quest.q_airport_upgrade_2_dialog_finish: Great job on mastering London Airlines! Maybe you can fly back to London soon and stay for a spell!
Quest.q_airport_upgrade_3_intro: You better go pack your bags because at the rate you’re upgrading, you’ll be taking lots of trips very, very soon!
Quest.q_airport_upgrade_3_dialog_header: You’ve really got this upgrading thing down pat! I bet you could collect from Cruises with your eyes closed!
Quest.q_airport_upgrade_3_task1_hint: Hint: Gives you Super Cargo Plane!
Quest.q_airport_upgrade_3_task3_hint: You really are master of your domain
Quest.q_alien_rescue_1_intro: Help an alien family re-unite with each other and earn an out-of-this-world reward!
Quest.q_alien_rescue_1_dialog_header: Our family will need a landmark in order to find each other! Their UFO should do!
Quest.q_alien_rescue_1_task1: Repair Alien Family's UFO to Level 2
Quest.q_alien_rescue_1_task2: Find Papa Alien and move him within the UFO's range
Quest.q_alien_rescue_1_task2_hint: The UFO's green ring defines it's range
Quest.q_alien_rescue_2_intro: The sky is the goal, not the limit! Keep your head out of the clouds and eyes on the prize!
Quest.q_alien_rescue_2_dialog_header: Find a few more estranged extraterrestrial family members to complete your mission!
Quest.q_alien_rescue_2_task1_hint: Collect parts to help with repairs!
Quest.q_alien_rescue_2_task2: Find and Move Mama Alien and Baby Alien in the UFO's range
Quest.q_alien_rescue_2_task3: Repair Alien Family's UFO to Level 4
Quest.q_alien_rescue_2_dialog_finish: Family is universal! Your kindness and good deeds will be known throughout the galaxy!
Quest.q_alien_rescue_3_intro: You're well on your way to helping these aliens complete their interstellar family!
Quest.q_alien_rescue_3_task3: Reunite the Alien Family by moving the Alien Dog in the UFO's range
Quest.q_alien_rescue_3_dialog_finish: We've done it! Your new alien friends are reunited, and now you've got a UFO!
Quest.q_aloha_island_intro: Build the Aloha Island to bring picturesque island living to your city today!
Quest.q_aloha_island_task2: Collect island parts and complete Aloha Island
Quest.q_aloha_island_task3: Collect from the Ferry Terminal 10 times
Quest.q_aloha_island_task3_hint: Your citizens want to go to the new Island
Quest.q_amex_treehouse_intro: Spruce up your city with the Serve Money Treehouse and complete the quest!
Quest.q_amex_treehouse_task1_hint: You will get 1 City Cash every day for 5 days
Quest.q_amex_treehouse_task2: Collect from your Serve Money Treehouse five times
Quest.q_amex_treehouse_task2_hint: Look out for more ways to earn FREE City Cash!
Quest.q_amphitheater_1_intro: Summer's around the corner and your citizens need a place to go to see their favorite bands live and in concert!
Quest.q_amphitheater_1_task1_hint: Bring Train and up to 5 other acts to your city
Quest.q_amphitheater_1_task3_hint: After each concert fans spend at businesses twice as fast
Quest.q_amphitheater_2_task2: Collect Train Tour Posters from Amphitheater Businesses or Ask friends
Quest.q_amphitheater_2_task2_hint: I hope we can get an autograph
Quest.q_amphitheater_2_task3: Hold Train Concerts in your Amphitheater
Quest.q_amphitheater_2_task3_hint: Earn a collection item after each concert
Quest.q_amphitheater_2_dialog_finish: I really love all of Train's tracks but my favorite Train track has to be "Hey, Soul Sister"! It's so catchy!
Quest.q_amphitheater_3_intro: I can't get that song, "Drops of Jupiter," out of my head!
Quest.q_amphitheater_3_task1: Hold Pop Star Concerts in your Amphitheater
Quest.q_amphitheater_3_task2_hint: Turn in the collection for a Limited Edition Train item
Quest.q_amphitheater_3_dialog_finish: Man, I can't get enough of this band. I wish there was an entire radio station dedicated only to Train songs!
Quest.q_arc_1_intro: I’m so glad I get to return to Paris for the holidays! I always get homesick this time of year and it will be nice to be back!
Quest.q_arc_1_dialog_hint: Complete all 3 goals to earn Andre’s House
Quest.q_arc_1_dialog_finish: It was so nice to see my mentor at his restaurant today! And it was also nice to see his French bulldog, Fergus!
Quest.q_arc_2_intro: I’ve been looking forward to visiting my friends and family but the real reason I’m here is for the French food!
Quest.q_arc_2_dialog_header: Let’s wander around Paris and see what all the best restaurants are serving these days!
Quest.q_arc_2_task1_hint: There’s so much to see in this city
Quest.q_arc_3_dialog_header: Even though I haven’t been here long, I’ve had a very well rounded trip! Let’s squeeze in a few more sights!
Quest.q_arc_3_dialog_finish: I’ll miss you, Paris! No matter where I live, you’ll always be my home! Until we meet again, my love!
Quest.q_area51_1_task2: Collect from UFO Themed Buildings 10 Times
Quest.q_area51_1_task2_hint: You can find Film in UFO themed buildings!
